Zwischen Kunden, Entwicklungsteam und Geschäftsführung sorgst du dafür, dass nichts liegen bleibt und jedes Projekt von Anfang bis Ende rundläuft. Du behältst den Überblick über unsere Projekte und begleitest sie über ihren gesamten Lebenszyklus.

Wichtiger als eine bestimmte Zahl an Berufsjahren ist uns, dass du strukturiert arbeitest, dich in technische Themen hineindenkst und Freude am Kundenkontakt hast. Auch wenn du aus einem angrenzenden Bereich kommst, zum Beispiel Fachinformatik, als IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau, aus dem Büro- oder Projektmanagement oder aus Medien- und Kommunikationsberufen, und Organisationstalent plus Technikaffinität mitbringst, freuen wir uns ausdrücklich über deine Bewerbung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du pflegst Scrum-Boards, hältst Tickets und Status nach, klärst offene Punkte mit der Projektleitung und den Entwicklern und bereitest die Sprints mit vor
  • Du organisierst Kundenmeetings und begleitest sie, meist gemeinsam mit Entwicklern und Projektleitung, inklusive Vorbereitung, Protokoll und Nachverfolgung
  • Du wirkst bei Softwaretests und Abnahmen mit
  • Du erstellst ausgehende Rechnungen und hältst Wiedervorlage und Dokumentation in Ordnung
  • Du arbeitest an Ausschreibungen mit und erstellst gemeinsam mit uns IT-Angebote

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Organisationsstärke und die Fähigkeit, viele Fäden gleichzeitig in der Hand zu halten
  • Sicheres, freundliches Auftreten in der Kundenkommunikation
  • Du bist technikaffin und bringst dein Wissen in IT-Angebote und Softwaretests ein
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1/C2)
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office; moderne KI-Tools nutzen wir im Alltag, du arbeitest dich gern ein
  • PLUS: Berufserfahrung in Projektkoordination, Projektassistenz oder im Angebots- und Vergabewesen
  • PLUS: Erfahrung mit Scrum oder agilen Abläufen

Benefits

Das bieten wir

  • Gehalt von 2.800 Euro brutto/Monat bei 32 Std./Woche (entspricht einem Vollzeitäquivalent von 42.000 Euro brutto/Jahr). Der Stundenumfang ist zwischen 30 und 40 Stunden vereinbar.
  • Ausbau der Position in Richtung Projektleitung ist möglich
  • Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, geförderte Zertifizierungen und Bildungsurlaub
  • Gleitzeitregelung innerhalb unserer Kernarbeitszeit
  • 30 Urlaubstage, unbefristeter Vertrag, BVG-Fahrausweis
  • Lunch-Zuschuss sowie kostenlose Getränke und Snacks im Büro
  • Budget für Gesundheitsförderung
  • We love Kids! Kita-Zuschuss und kinderfreundliche Arbeitsbedingungen
  • Vierbeinige Kollegen willkommen! Bring deinen Hund mit ins Büro. 🐕
  • Langfristige Kunden aus öffentlicher Hand und Mittelstand
  • Nach ISO 9001 und ISO 27001 zertifiziert (TÜV Süd)
  • Zentrales Büro zwischen Rosa-Luxemburg-Platz und Alexanderplatz

Es handelt sich um eine Präsenzstelle mit fünf Arbeitstagen pro Woche in Berlin-Mitte.

  • Praktische Erfahrungen in einem schlagkräftigen Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung von Individualsoftware und Online-Plattformen spezialisiert hat
  • Moderne Stacks, kein Wordpress, Joomla o.ä.
  • Arbeit an spannenden Projekten und die Möglichkeit, moderne Technologien kennenzulernen

  • Laufende oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung, Weiterbildung, Umschulung, Fortbildung oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Fachinformatik für Anwendungsentwicklung, Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik etc.

  • Leistungsbereitschaft (!), Eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Kreativität und Flexibilität
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Begeisterung für moderne Technologien
  • Idealerweise ein Faible für Superhelden-Filme

Benefits

Das bieten wir:

  • Ein Praktikum für mindestens fünf Monate, das Du für dein Studium oder deine Ausbildung anerkennen lassen kannst
  • Eine Praktikumsvergütung in Abhängigkeit der Vorerfahrungen
  • Eine Übernahme in eine Festanstellung bei erfolgreichem Abschluss (30 Urlaubstage, Verpflegung, Flexzeit, Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, BVG-Ausweis, Bildungsurlaub etc.)
  • Einen strukturierten Ausbildungsplan
  • Pair Programming Sessions mit erfahrenen Entwicklern
  • We love Kids! Zuschuss zur Kita und kinderfreundliche Bedingungen
  • Ein motiviertes und freundliches Team, das dich jederzeit unterstützt und dir ein hervorragendes Arbeitsklima bietet
  • Gratis Kaffee, Tee und Getränke, sowie Wirtschaftsmagazine
  • Ein zentral gelegenes Office in Berlin Mitte, mit ausgezeichneter Anbindung an öffentliche Verkehrsmittel zwischen Rosa-Luxemburg-Platz und Alexanderplatz
  • Dress code? Be dressed!
  • Vierbeinige Kollegen willkommen - bringe deinen Hund mit ins Büro
  • Wir sind zertifiziert vom TÜV Süd

Du fühlst dich angesprochen? description: <h2><strong>Kurz und knapp</strong></h2> <p>Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?<br><br>Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in <strong>Falkensee</strong> bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der <em>Bill &amp; Melinda Gates Foundation</em> bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.<br><br><strong>Sei von Anfang an dabei:</strong> Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes FC in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen FC in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten FC in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/erdeY5trkMA" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>Das erwartet dich&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Teamleitung: </strong>Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers.</li> <li><strong>Schichtleitung: </strong>Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.</li> <li><strong>Abwechslung:</strong> Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche).</li> <li><strong>Prozessoptimierung: </strong>Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang aufs nächste Level.</li> <li><strong>Ownership:</strong> Du hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, auch wenn Dinge mal außerhalb deines unmittelbaren Bereichs liegen. Du schaust über den Tellerrand hinaus und nimmst die Dinge proaktiv selbst in die Hand.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Das bringst du mit</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ein abgeschlossenes Studium (Bachelor oder Master) in Logistikmanagement, Supply Chain Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.</li> <li>Du brennst für die Logistik und bringst idealerweise erste Einblicke aus dem Lagerbereich mit (z. B. durch Praktika oder ein Werkstudium).</li> <li>Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch &amp; Englisch und bringst die nötige Flexibilität für die Arbeit in zwei Schichten (6:00 – 14:30 Uhr &amp; 14:30 – 23:00 Uhr, auch samstags) mit.</li> <li>Ein extrem hohes Maß an Eigenantrieb. Du siehst Dinge von selbst, nimmst sie proaktiv in die Hand und übernimmst Verantwortung – auch über deinen eigenen Tellerrand hinaus.</li> <li>Ein echtes, intrinsisches Interesse an Menschen. Du bist empathisch, nahbar und liebst es, dein Team zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns:</strong> Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Projekte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, neue Ideen zu testen und direkt miterleben zu können, wie deine Arbeit in unserem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen Wirkung zeigt.</li> <li><strong>Nachhaltigkeit als Kern:</strong> Werde Teil der Revolution. Du trägst zu einer grüneren Zukunft bei – durch unsere 100 % elektrische Flotte und eine Lieferkette, die Lebensmittelverschwendung reduziert.</li> <li><strong>Die Basics:</strong> Wir stellen dir alles für deinen Erfolg bereit – inklusive Laptop und Handy sowie Zugang zu exklusiven Mitarbeiter-Rabatten (Corporate Benefits) für Reisen, Technik und vieles mehr.</li> <li><strong>Zeit zum Auftanken:</strong> Mit 30 Urlaubstagen pro Jahr (bei einer 40-Stunden-Woche) sorgst du für den perfekten Ausgleich zwischen Arbeit und Erholung.</li> <li><strong>Verpflegung für Gewinner:</strong> Wir kümmern uns um dich. Genieße jeden Tag ein frisches, kostenloses Frühstück, Mittag- und Abendessen in unserem Fulfilment Center, dazu gibt es reichlich Snacks und Obst für den Energiekick zwischendurch.</li> <li><strong>Unvergessliche Momente:</strong> Wir sind mehr als nur ein Team. Von unserem legendären jährlichen Ski-Trip über Weihnachtsfeiern bis hin zu Auftritten unserer eigenen Picnic-Band: Wir feiern unsere Erfolge gemeinsam.</li> <li><strong>Individuelle Mobilität:</strong> &nbsp;Du entscheidest, wie du zu uns kommst. Du erhältst einen Firmenwagen (auch zur privaten Nutzung) und kostenlose Parkplätze an den Picnic Standorten stehen dir zur Verfügung. Dazu bieten wir ein „Lease-a-Bike“-Programm an.</li> <li><strong>Lebensmittelretter:</strong> Hol dir unsere exklusiven "Too-Good-To-Go"-Tüten und rette leckere Lebensmittel – nur für unsere Mitarbeitenden!</li> <li><strong>Lerne &amp; wachse:</strong> Profitiere von internen Lern- &amp; Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch spannende Workshops und intensive Bootcamps, um deine Skills ständig zu erweitern.</li> <li><strong>Absicherung für morgen:</strong> Wir unterstützen dich mit einem überdurchschnittlichen Zuschuss zur Betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, damit du auch an später denkst.</li> </ul> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Commercial Lead, DACH
raw.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We’re looking for an experienced seller with an entrepreneurial mindset to help build Heidi’s next stage of growth across Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

There’s already momentum: clinicians using the product, customers recommending us and healthcare organisations coming to us with interest. You’ll build on that foundation by closing strategically important deals, creating new pipeline and turning individual adoption into broader organisational relationships.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a broad commercial remit. You’ll personally own opportunities from first conversation to signed agreement, while helping us develop partnerships, strengthen our market presence and figure out where to focus next.

You might spend one day building a business case with a hospital group, the next prospecting into a priority account, and another working with a potential partner or helping shape a local event. You’ll bring the judgement to choose what matters and the follow-through to make it happen.

 

What you’ll do

  • Own strategically important deals: Lead opportunities with practice groups, MVZs, clinics and hospital groups from discovery and demos through business case development, negotiation and close. Build relationships with clinical champions, operational leaders and executive decision-makers.

  • Build your own pipeline: Identify the accounts and segments worth pursuing, develop a clear approach and do the outreach yourself. Use targeted prospecting, introductions, local networks and creative approaches to open conversations.

  • Convert the demand coming to us: Respond quickly to inbound interest and use product adoption signals to uncover larger opportunities. Recognise when an enthusiastic clinician could become the starting point for a practice-wide or group-wide rollout.

  • Help buyers reach a decision: Understand their workflows, priorities and buying process. Bring the right stakeholders together, coordinate internal support on technical, security and procurement questions, and give pilots clear success criteria and a route to rollout.

  • Help build the wider market: Develop relationships with software providers, professional associations, clinical advocates and other potential partners. Work with colleagues on conferences, webinars, customer stories and commercial initiatives that create trust and qualified demand.

  • Improve how we sell: Turn what you learn into better messaging, account prioritisation and sales processes. Use AI and commercial tools to improve your effectiveness, keep the CRM accurate and maintain a realistic view of your pipeline and forecast.

  • Bring the market back into Heidi: Share clear evidence about why customers buy, what slows adoption and where product improvements or localisation could unlock growth. Work closely with Product, Marketing, Customer Success and the wider DACH team.

 

What you'll need

  • A proven record of selling and closing: You’ve personally owned a revenue target and can explain the deals you originated, how you won them and the results you delivered. Experience in B2B software or a similarly complex commercial environment is particularly relevant.

  • Strong sales craft: You know how to run discovery, build a compelling business case, develop champions and navigate opportunities involving several stakeholders. You can earn credibility with both a clinician and a CFO.

  • The ability to create opportunities: You’ve built pipeline through your own efforts and know how to turn an account list or a promising introduction into meaningful commercial progress.

  • A generalist’s range and judgement: You enjoy work beyond the immediate deal: testing a channel, developing a partnership, organising a customer session or solving a problem that is holding growth back. You can balance that breadth with delivering your number.

  • Independence and pace: You create structure when the playbook is still being written, make sensible decisions with incomplete information and follow through without being chased.

  • Fluent German and strong English: You can lead nuanced commercial conversations in German and work effectively with a global team.

  • Curiosity about healthcare and AI: You’ll learn the product properly, take clinicians’ concerns seriously and use AI thoughtfully in your own work. You’re open to feedback and willing to change your approach when the evidence changes.

Particularly useful experience

  • Being an early AE or helping grow a new territory at a scaling company.

  • Selling into DACH healthcare or another complex, regulated market.

  • Building partnerships or turning individual product usage into larger organisational deals.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

We take care of you.

We offer 25 days of paid time off per year, 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder, a €100/month Healthy Heidi's wellness stipend, a €500 home office budget, a €700 annual learning and development budget, 26 weeks paid primary parental leave and 18 weeks paid secondary parental leave, fertility support up to €7,000, up to four weeks of work from anywhere per year, Recharge Days after major milestones and busy periods, 10 days per year of clinical leave for eligible clinical roles, and a hybrid working environment with 3 days in the office.

We chose to open-source our benefits hub, if you care to take a peek.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

title: Social Content Manager
description: Bei Jellyfish glauben wir an die Kraft vielfältiger Perspektiven und an eine inklusive Zusammenarbeit. Wir begrüßen Menschen, die in diversen, kollaborativen Teams über sich hinauswachsen und die individuellen Sichtweisen anderer schätzen. Jellyfish ist eine globale Digital Marketing Agentur – eine einzigartige Verbindung aus Tech-Enthusiast:innen, kreativen Köpfen sowie Media- und Daten-Expert:innen, die ein gemeinsames Ziel vereint: unsere Kund:innen auf ihrer digitalen Reise weiterzubringen. Unser Anspruch, unterschiedliche Blickwinkel aktiv einzubinden, ist der Treibstoff für unsere innovativen Lösungen und Strategien. Wir hinterfragen den Status quo, denken Media-Aktivierung neu und entwickeln Stories mit Wirkkraft, für unsere internationalen Kund:innen und deren Zielgruppen. Gestalte mit uns eine Zukunft, in der berufliche und persönliche Weiterentwicklung Hand in Hand gehen. Stellenbeschreibung Du berichtest direkt an den Senior Social Content Manager und sorgst vom ersten Tag an für spürbaren Impact in unserer paneuropäischen Social-Creative-Abteilung. Wir sind stolz auf unsere langjährigen Partnerschaften mit globalen Entertainment-Größen und auf unsere Arbeit, die Kultur prägt und sich von der Masse abhebt. Von unserem Berliner Hub aus – mit echter hybrider Flexibilität – treibst du Social-First-Storytelling und kulturelle Relevanz für eine führende Streaming-Marke auf dem deutschen Markt voran. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem agilen Netzwerk aus Editor:innen, Designer:innen und Integrated Producer:innen in Berlin, London, Paris und Madrid steuerst du alles – von dynamischen Vertical Videos (TikTok und Instagram) über Creator-Kooperationen bis hin zur Live-Begleitung von Events vor Ort. Mit echtem kreativen Gestaltungsspielraum und einer offenen, kollegialen Unternehmenskultur bieten wir dir ein Umfeld, in dem mutige Ideen wachsen können. Deine Aufgaben Social Account Management Du arbeitest direkt mit einem großen Entertainment-Streaming-Kunden zusammen, pitchst eigene Kreativkonzepte und stimmst strategische Ziele gemeinsam ab. Du entwickelst herausragende Social-Aktivierungen für große Film- und Serienstarts sowie für saisonale und kulturelle Highlights. Du adaptierst globale Kampagnen-Assets und Toolkits für den deutschen Markt und passt Botschaften an, sodass diese lokale kulturelle Nuancen treffen. Du verantwortest die Social-First-Begleitung bei Live-Events, Marketing-Shoots und Presseveranstaltungen und briefst und leitest Talente vor Ort souverän an. Du übernimmst das gesamte kreative Copywriting über alle Formate hinweg – von Videoskripten und Interviewfragen bis hin zu In-Asset-Texten und plattformgerechten Captions. Du pflegst plattformübergreifende Redaktionspläne und koordinierst die tägliche Planung und Veröffentlichung freigegebener Inhalte auf allen organischen Kanälen. Social Media Expertise Du behältst Plattform-Updates, neue Nutzungsgewohnheiten und Popkultur-Trends in Echtzeit im Blick, um proaktiv reaktiven, kulturell relevanten Content zu pitchen. Du beobachtest Community-Stimmen sowie Performance-Daten nach dem Launch und übersetzt Analysen in fundierte Kampagnen-Debriefs, Abschlussberichte und konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für Kund:innen. Projektmanagement Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Design, Redaktion und Integrated Production zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Assets entlang Briefing, pünktlich und exakt im Einklang mit den Markenrichtlinien der Kund:innen geliefert werden. Du sorgst für reibungslose interne Produktionsabläufe, indem du verlässliche Zeitpläne erstellst und pflegst, Feedbackschleifen mit Kund:innen steuerst und Freigabeprozesse vom Briefing bis zum finalen Sign-off souverän begleitest. Dein Profil Deutsch auf C2- oder Muttersprachniveau mit einem sicheren Gespür für Copywriting, das auf Social-Media-Kanäle und den jeweiligen Tone of Voice der Marke zugeschnitten ist. Verhandlungssicheres Englisch im Arbeitsalltag. Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Konzeption, dem Scripting und der Produktion von Social Content auf nationalem Kampagnenniveau. Sicherer Umgang mit TikTok, Meta, YouTube und X sowie praktische Erfahrung mit Publishing- und Management-Tools wie der Meta Business Suite oder Sprinklr. Erfahrung im Community Management sowie ein intuitives Verständnis für Audience Engagement, Tone of Voice von Marken und plattformtypische Kommunikation. Tiefes Eintauchen in die deutsche Jugendkultur, Entertainment-Trends und Online-Fandoms – verbunden mit dem Talent, spontane Internet-Momente in mitreißenden Content zu verwandeln. Starke, teamorientierte Kommunikation über alle Touchpoints hinweg (vom täglichen Chat bis hin zu formellen Kundencalls und Präsentationen) sowie ein Händchen dafür, langfristiges Vertrauen und partnerschaftliche Beziehungen aufzubauen. Bei Herausforderungen holst du die richtigen Leute an einen Tisch, wägst verschiedene Optionen ab und findest pragmatische Lösungen. Hinweis: Wir legen mehr Wert auf Fähigkeiten, Fachwissen und persönliche Eigenschaften als auf langjährige Berufserfahrung oder klassische Studienabschlüsse. Wenn du Teil unseres kooperativen Teams werden möchtest, bewirb dich noch heute mit deinem Lebenslauf auf Englisch . Weitere Infos Werde Teil von Jellyfish und erlebe ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem deine Weiterentwicklung Priorität hat, deine Erfolge gefeiert werden und du deinen Arbeitsalltag so gestalten kannst, wie es am besten zu dir passt. 💫 Flexibles Arbeitsumfeld: Arbeite bis zu 60 % deiner Zeit remote und gestalte deinen Arbeitstag dank flexibler Arbeitszeiten frei zwischen 8:00 und 18:30 Uhr. 📈 Weiterbildung nach deinen Vorstellungen: Sammle jeden Monat einen bezahlten Weiterbildungstag (2 Stunden pro Woche) für deine persönliche Entwicklung und nutze vollen Zugriff auf Jellyfish Learn. Leider häufen sich aktuell Fälle, in denen sich gefälschte Recruiter:innen als Jellyfish ausgeben und unseren Markennamen unrechtmäßig verwenden. Wenn du dir unsicher bist, ob eine E-Mail mit einem Jobangebot wirklich von Jellyfish stammt, oder wenn du einen Betrugsversuch vermutest, melde dies bitte an • €45K – €50K Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Founders Associate Finance - (AI x Greentech) (m/f/d)
description: Are you eager to become the financial backbone of one of Europe’s fastest-growing renewable energy startups? Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you can drive impact, spot problems, and build solutions from scratch? Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent. YOUR IMPACT At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing. Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects. WHAT YOU WILL DO Build, assemble and modify prototypes, experimental hardware, custom tooling and development rigs for engineering and special projects across the programme. Turn engineering drawings, models, and sketches into practical hardware. Clarify missing requirements and agree the build approach with the responsible engineer before committing to uncertain or irreversible steps. Fabricate and adapt components using fitting, cutting, drilling, soldering, bonding and assembly techniques within your competence. Coordinate specialist machining, welding or other work when needed. Identify buildability issues early, including tolerance stacks, inaccessible fasteners, component fit and assembly sequence, and provide practical feedback to the design team. Prepare and run development trials, including winding, joining, insulation and impregnation trials as assigned. Install instrumentation, commission rigs with engineers, take measurements and record what changed and what happened. Investigate unexpected behaviour, propose practical fixes and work through build-test-modify iterations with engineers. Organise the practical delivery of assigned projects: source small parts and consumables through agreed purchasing routes, arrange tools and build activities, and keep the workshop ready for use. Communicate progress, blockers and changing priorities to the lead technician. Keep clear as-built records, annotated drawings, photographs, settings and trial observations so another technician can reproduce the work and understand each modification. Transfer proven prototypes and methods to manufacturing or routine testing through initial work instructions, tooling, assembly sequences, training and technical handovers. Work with engineers to identify hazards and establish the necessary risk assessments and controls before starting work on unproven hardware. WHO YOU ARE A technical apprenticeship or vocational qualification in mechanical, electrical, mechatronic or related engineering work, or equivalent hands-on experience. Hands-on experience building, modifying and troubleshooting mechanical or electromechanical hardware in a workshop, laboratory, development or advanced manufacturing environment. The ability to interpret engineering drawings, tolerances and 3D models, with working familiarity with geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) and practical measurement skills. Confident hand-tool and workshop skills, sound fabrication and assembly judgement, and a willingness to develop unfamiliar techniques. Resourcefulness with incomplete information: you investigate, ask useful questions, find suitable parts and propose a practical next step while keeping the engineering objective clear. Sound judgement about technical uncertainty, safety and when a build or design change requires engineering review before proceeding. The ability to organise work, adapt to agreed priority changes and document configurations and findings clearly. Working English for technical discussions, drawings, instructions and build records. Nice to have Specialist fabrication skills such as manual or CNC machining, sheet-metal work, welding, brazing or additive manufacturing. Experience creating or modifying simple parts and fixtures in CATIA, SolidWorks, Fusion 360 or similar CAD tools. Experience with instrumentation, sensors, data acquisition, electrical wiring, vacuum, cryogenics or superconducting hardware. Experience with composites, resins, vacuum bagging, insulation or impregnation. Experience taking first-of-a-kind hardware or a prototype process through to repeatable manufacturing and technical handover. German language skills. Incident management & reliability

  • Drive down how often incidents happen, how long it takes us to notice them, and how long it takes to fix them, with a focus on catching problems with monitors instead of by chance

  • Lead post-incident reviews, translate learnings into systemic improvements, and make sure follow-up actions actually get done

  • Build tooling and runbooks that enable teams to detect, diagnose and resolve production issues faster

  • Champion a culture of blameless incident handling and continuous improvement

Observability & production confidence

  • Advance our Datadog-based observability practice — metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and alerting

  • Help teams set measurable reliability targets with actionable alerts that reach the right owner — not alert fatigue

  • Enable production debugging capabilities so engineers can triage issues without needing a specialist

Change confidence & release quality

  • Reduce how often changes cause failures in production by helping teams find and close the biggest gaps in their automated testing

  • Make testing and CI faster and more reliable for product teams, so engineers trust their tests instead of working around them

  • Identify blast radius risks and architectural gaps in evolving systems, and drive mitigation

  • Reduce the cost and risk of deployments through better tooling, feature flagging, and progressive rollout practices

Platform enablement

  • Design and maintain paved paths: well - documented golden paths for development, observability, testing, and incident response so engineering teams can do the right things by default

  • Work hands-on with product teams using Java and React to help them improve system design, testability, and operational hygiene

  • Draw on Kubernetes, AWS, and service mesh expertise to guide product teams on infrastructure best practices

  • Make infrastructure cost visible to teams and help them find and act on efficiency opportunities

  • Leverage AI tooling to accelerate incident response, improve developer workflows, and scale operational practices

Your toolkit

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience

  • Deep understanding of observability tooling — we use Datadog (metrics, APM, logs, dashboards) — and of what makes alerts and production debugging effective

  • Track record of improving the reliability of production systems at scale

  • Strong coding skills in Java; comfortable reading and contributing in Go across infrastructure contexts; enough frontend context to collaborate with React / Vue teams

  • Working experience with Kubernetes and AWS, and familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio/Envoy)

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, networking, and container technology

  • Hands-on experience with automated testing across unit, integration, and end-to-end levels, as well as CI/CD and build systems

  • Hands-on, everyday use of AI in your engineering work

  • You work well across teams and raise standards through partnership

  • Communicates in clear, concise English: you listen to understand, adapt to your audience, and make sure people know what to do next

  • Positive, proactive team player who is passionate about operational excellence and who helps others deliver

What sets you apart

  • You have led improvements that reached many teams at once, not just your own, with results you can point to

  • You have helped teams ship with more confidence and fewer production surprises

  • You have embedded operational excellence practices into the culture of product engineering teams, not just platform teams

  • You have helped teams cut or avoid cost through technical or operational improvements

  • You have driven AI adoption beyond yourself: workflows you built are relied on by others and visibly changed how they work

raw.title: Principal AI Engineer (x/f/m)
raw.description:
We are looking for a Principal AI Engineer to join the Practice Efficiency team at Doctolib.

Your mission will be to define and deliver how AI transforms the daily work of healthcare professionals — through intelligent scheduling, automated document processing, smart task management, and AI-assisted patient communication. As a Principal-level individual contributor, you will own the deepest technical challenges within the Practice Efficiency scope: setting the AI architecture bar, driving rigorous evaluation standards, and directly shaping how AI-powered features reach healthcare professionals and their patients at scale — starting with the Phone Assistant, currently one of Doctolib's most strategic product bets.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Own end-to-end AI architecture decisions for Practice Efficiency — from model selection and agentic system design to production deployment patterns,, and strategic build vs. buy calls

  • Architect and deliver agentic applications at scale, defining how Practice Efficiency AI features are structured, evaluated, and iterated on in production

  • Design robust, scalable AI infrastructure: model and prompt versioning, guardrails, uncertainty quantification, cost optimisation, and observability — enabling the team to ship reliably and fast

  • Lead the technical delivery of the Phone Assistant's AI capabilities, balancing ambitious product ambitions with engineering rigour and production reliability

  • Ensure responsible AI delivery in a regulated healthcare context, embedding explainability, GDPR/HDS compliance, and human-in-the-loop design across all Practice Efficiency AI features

  • Partner closely with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to translate customer and business needs into sound technical decisions, acting as a bridge between engineering depth and product delivery

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have 10+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on building AI products — including experience building AI systems before the rise of large language models, giving you strong fundamentals in evaluation, data pipelines, and system design under uncertainty

  • Have a strong background in building and operating large-scale distributed systems — we value deep systems engineering expertise and will consider profiles who bring exceptional scale experience alongside a solid grounding in AI

  • Have hands-on experience designing and shipping agentic applications, with a clear understanding of the challenges around reliability, observability, and evaluation in production agentic systems

  • Are product-centric by nature: you have worked closely with Product Managers and product organisations, bring genuine business sense and customer closeness, and see yourself as part of the product delivery chain — not just the technical one

  • Are fluent in English

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with LLM fine-tuning, RAG systems, or automatic speech recognition in production environments

  • Have built AI products in healthcare, financial services, or another regulated domain where safety and auditability are non-negotiable

  • Have contributed to or built shared AI platforms used by multiple product teams

Life at Doctolib Tech

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to country and healthcare specialty requirements.

  • Our stack in this product area is Ruby on Rails and TypeScript/React in the monolith, Kotlin for new services, with Postgres, Redis and Kafka underneath.

  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here.

Want to learn more about our tech culture and environment? Visit the Doctolib Tech site.

What we offer

  • A Deutschlandticket (Germany-wide public transport pass) fully paid for by Doctolib

  • 28 vacation days + 1 additional day for each full calendar year of employment (up to a maximum of 30 days)

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Company health insurance with great supplementary benefits through our partner Allianz

  • Company pension scheme (bAV) through Allianz with an employer subsidy of 40% (15% within the probationary period)

  • The Doctolib Parent Care program, which includes one month additional parental leave and much more

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Subsidized sports membership through our partner Urban Sports Club

  • A flexible workplace policy offering both hybrid and office-based mode

  • Alongside healthy snacks and our regular breakfast buffet, we provide a subsidized meal benefit

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

  • Relocation support in case of international mobility

  • Access to the best AI tools for coding, development and dedicated training

Our interview process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • System Design Interview

  • Behavioral Interview

  • Engineering Manager Case

  • At least one reference check

We want your experience to be clear, respectful, and transparent. Learn more about our hiring process on our candidate experience page.

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Ruby on Rails, TypeScript, Kotlin

  • Full-time

  • Location: Berlin

  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)

  • Start date: as soon as possible

We welcome everyone

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, or disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g., pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process.

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

Your data privacy

All information provided is processed by Doctolib for application management. For data processing details, click here: Germany | France | Italy | Netherlands. Please contact hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com for inquiries or to exercise your rights.

title: Senior IT Administrator (w/m/d)
description: Jobbeschreibung StackFuel ist seit Jahren einer der führenden Anbieter für Daten- und KI-Weiterbildung in Deutschland. Seit Anfang 2026 sind wir Teil von Multiverse, Europas einzigem EdTech-Unicorn und der größten AI-Upskilling-Plattform des Kontinents. Gemeinsam verfolgen wir ein klares Ziel: 100.000 Beschäftigte in Deutschland fit für KI zu machen und so die Daten- und KI-Kompetenzlücke im Land zu schließen. Du steigst als zentrale IT-Ansprechperson für Deutschland bei uns ein, mit Sitz in Berlin und Verantwortung für die Standorte Berlin, München und Düsseldorf sowie für Kolleg:innen im Remote-Setup in der DACH-Region. Du berichtest an die globale IT-Leitung in Großbritannien, arbeitest eng mit dem UK-basierten Enterprise-Technology-Team zusammen und verantwortest den IT-Alltag in Deutschland mit hoher Eigenständigkeit. Dazu gehört die technische Integration von StackFuel in die IT-Landschaft von Multiverse. Deine Aufgaben Du bist die lokale IT-Ansprechperson in Deutschland und bietest schnellen, verlässlichen Support auf Deutsch und Englisch. title: Senior Media Relations Manager (m/f/d)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You would own Mews' relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day.</p> <p>You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold.</p> <p>Journalists respond to people they know and trust, not to mass pitches, and the strongest coverage comes from a specialist who holds those relationships personally. Mews has strong stories and data to offer, and this role exists so that someone owns that conversation: choosing the right journalist for each story, answering inbound questions quickly and accurately, and knowing when to escalate something sensitive. Done well, it builds the company's reputation with the people who cover our industry over the long term.</p> <h4>What you would do</h4> <ul> <li>Build and maintain direct relationships with journalists across hospitality, travel, technology and business media: develop stories with the communications team, pitch them proactively by phone and email, host press briefings and invite journalists to events such as Unfold.</li> <li>Respond to inbound press enquiries (currently two to three a week and growing) quickly and accurately, and escalate anything potentially sensitive to the communications lead straight away.</li> <li>Brief and coach executive and local spokespeople, and share what you learn from journalists with leadership.</li> <li>Redesign how media monitoring, journalist research and coverage reporting work using AI, and set the workflows up so the rest of the team can use them.</li> <li>Own and improve the team's media management tool, and check every AI-assisted pitch, briefing or summary before it reaches a journalist.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> in this role that means you have gone well beyond using AI to draft copy. You have redesigned parts of how media relations work gets done, such as monitoring, journalist research or coverage reporting, you have built approaches that colleagues now follow, and you actively question and check what AI gives you, including target lists, summaries and quotes, before anything reaches a journalist or a spokesperson.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <h4>What you would bring</h4> <ul> <li>Seven to ten years in PR and communications with depth in B2B media relations, including time in a PR agency.</li> <li>Your own journalist contacts and hands-on experience pitching by phone, email and in person, with fully fluent English, written and spoken.</li> <li>A record of handling reactive and sensitive press enquiries under time pressure, with clear habits about when to escalate.</li> <li>Confidence preparing senior and non-expert spokespeople for press conversations.</li> <li>AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience, shown through tools or workflows you have built for media relations work, not only content you have written with AI.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to have</h4> <ul> <li>French or German alongside fluent English, or existing relationships with journalists in the UK, France, Germany or the US.</li> <li>Experience with B2B technology clients or in hospitality.</li> <li>Experience measuring coverage and coordinating local expertise in markets where you have fewer contacts.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Germany</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€71.500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€93.000 EUR</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: <p><strong>SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER</strong></p> <p>Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to <strong>Unleash the Potential</strong> of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.&nbsp; Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,800 teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success.&nbsp;</p> <h4><strong>WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for a <strong>Senior Software Engineer</strong> to help build the Perch camera system,&nbsp;</p> <p>Based in Europe (remote), you will work across platform, perception, and ML systems. You will help us improve how we collect, process, and analyze performance data at scale, spanning from devices collecting real-time to backend services and ML infrastructure. All of which will have a direct impact on customers and their experiences with the product.</p> <p>This role suits a strong generalist who has seen many parts of engineering. You might have worked on any of the following: high-throughput systems, computer vision, robotics, ML infrastructure, or other complex applications. Our ideal candidate brings strong engineering judgment, good technical range, and the ability to learn quickly.</p> <p>You will be hands-on, working in Python and C++ on devices and services in use by our customers every day.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li><em>Design and implement algorithms for 3D object tracking, segmentation, and motion recognition on embedded hardware.</em></li> <li><em>Train and iterate on ML models — from dataset curation through training, evaluation, and deployment to edge devices.</em></li> <li><em>Help bring ML, computer vision, or signal-processing systems into production with tight performance constraints</em></li> <li><em>Build reliable application features and services that customers use in real environments.</em></li>   • Hands-on experience debugging hardware interfaces at protocol level, including I2C, SPI, UART, and SDIO
  • Solid understanding of embedded security concepts such as Secure Boot, TrustZone (TEE), dm-verity, encryption, and hardware-backed key storage

raw.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

About the Team

DashOS is DoorDash's merchant technology platform. It brings together the products restaurants and local businesses use to run their own business, sell on their own channels and keep their guests coming back, including online ordering, websites and apps, and loyalty. DashOS connects these tools with the demand and growth learnings of the DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo marketplaces, so merchants can grow both on our marketplaces and on their own channels.

In EMEA, we are building DashOS market by market. The team is small and works like a startup within the larger DoorDash. When joining DashOS, you will help shape a new business from an early stage: what we offer merchants to fuel their growth, how we take it to market and how we support merchants once they are live.

Our Strategy & Operations team builds the DashOS business end to end in EMEA: what we focus on, how we measure success, and the playbooks that make growth repeatable. We work in small cross-functional pods that find improvement opportunities, launch and iterate, together with Product, Engineering, Analytics, Finance, Legal, Marketing, our merchant and consumer teams.

About the Role

We are now looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Operations to build the commercial engine behind DashOS. You will own the systems, numbers and operating rhythm that turn a multi-product strategy into predictable revenue, across all DoorDash, Wolt and Deliveroo markets in EMEA.

What you'll be doing

As the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations for DashOS EMEA, you will partner directly with DashOS commercial leadership to co-own the go-to-market plan and run the operating cadence for the sales and account management teams selling DashOS. This is a senior individual contributor role for a builder: you will set up the tracking and planning foundations, then use them to make the sales organisation measurably better.

Day-to-day in this role you'll:

  • Build the revenue tracking infrastructure: own our CRM setup and the data flows into our BI stack, so pipeline, activities and revenue for every DashOS product live in one place
  • Run the commercial operating cadence, including pipeline tracking, pacing and weekly forecasting with sales and account managers, and own the DashOS commercial narrative to EMEA leadership
  • Own sales planning across markets: set targets and quotas through bottom-up and top-down allocation, and design books of business, territories and coverage models that match our growth goals
  • Turn sales performance data into action by building dashboards that act as the single source of truth for account-level performance and risk, and surfacing insights that managers and sellers can act on
  • Design and roll out incentive systems, including MBOs, SPIFFs and variable compensation, together with Finance, so sales and account managers own DashOS revenue alongside marketplace revenue
  • Make DashOS part of the core commercial motion, so it shows up in every account manager's book of business, account plans and business reviews rather than running on the side
  • Automate and scale with AI, removing manual work for sellers and managers (e.g. pre-populated account plans, automated pipeline views) so teams spend their time with merchants

Our humble expectations

  • Significant experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations or a similar commercial role, ideally in a fast-growing tech company. A management consulting background is a plus.
  • A track record in sales planning: quota and target setting, territory and book-of-business design, and forecasting cadences for a multi-market sales organisation.
  • Hands-on with data and systems. You are comfortable with SQL and BI tools (e.g. Looker, Tableau) and have worked deeply in a CRM such as Salesforce. You build things yourself rather than only writing specs.
  • Experience designing incentive models, variable pay structures, SPIFFs and performance tracking across commercial teams.
  • A builder and generalist who is comfortable with ambiguity, can take a broad mandate and turn it into concrete outputs, and doesn't need a fully built stack to deliver.
  • A clear communicator and trusted partner to senior leaders, able to translate data into a commercial narrative and build alignment across Sales, Finance and Product.
  • Strong understanding of distinct sales motions, including Enterprise Sales, SMB Sales and Account Management. Experience with multi-product or platform sales is a plus.
  • Bonus: experience using AI and automation to scale commercial operations.

Why join us

You will do work that matters and help build one of DoorDash's next big bets. Working here, you can expect to:

  • Make a visible impact every day, directly improving how merchants run and grow their business.
  • Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment, with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.
  • Build a career, not just a role, as DashOS grows across EMEA.
  • Deliver together in an inclusive, diverse and values-driven culture, with big hearts and small egos.

Next steps

If you are excited about building a new business from an early stage and taking real ownership, click below to apply, add your CV and get the conversation going! We review applications on an ongoing basis. 💙

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

description: Warum roadsurfer? TEAMSPIRIT & TEAM-EVENTS: Flache Hierarchien, viel Spaß, ein starker Teamspirit und regelmäßige Events wie gemeinsame Sport-Sessions oder Pizza- & Bier-Abende. PERSÖNLICHE ENTWICKLUNG: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem individuellen Growth Plan und unserer Inhouse Academy. CAMPER-BUDGET: Ein jährliches Camper-Budget, damit du den #happyroadsurfing-Lifestyle selbst erleben kannst. Halte 4.000+ Camper auf der Straße Als Head of Fleet Operations DACH sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Camper startklar sind, wenn unsere Gäste losfahren wollen. Du führst unsere 2 Senior Fleet Technicians, 5 Regional Fleet Manager und damit indirekt die Fleet Manager, Techniker:innen und Schadensexpert:innen an über 40 Stationen in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz. Du berichtest direkt an unseren Business Director DACH und bist Teil des DACH-Leadership-Teams. Was dich erwartet: ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen, ein junges, motiviertes Team und viel, das noch aufgebaut werden will. Nicht jeder Prozess existiert schon – viele davon gestaltest du selbst. Wenn du für deine Arbeit fertige Strukturen brauchst, ist das wahrscheinlich nicht das Richtige für dich. Du baust unser Netz aus internen und externen Werkstätten und Servicepartnern auf und steuerst es. Du legst Reparaturstrategien fest und sorgst dafür, dass Ersatzteile und Werkstattkapazitäten fließen. Du führst und entwickelst deine Regional Fleet Manager und hebst das Level der Teams an unseren Stationen. Du steuerst über KPIs (Reparaturkosten, Durchlaufzeit, Verfügbarkeit, Schadenserkennung) und treibst Verbesserungen voran. Du arbeitest eng mit den Regional Operations Managern zusammen, die die P&L der Stationen verantworten. Wo du herkommen könntest Du musst nicht aus der Camper- oder Autovermietung kommen. Vielleicht leitest du gerade Fleet- oder Field-Operations bei einem Mobility-Scale-up (Carsharing, E-Bikes, Scooter), in einer Service-Organisation mit Techniker:innen im Außendienst (Solar, Wärmepumpen, Ladeinfrastruktur, Aufzüge, Medizintechnik) oder in der Instandhaltung von Bahnen oder Flugzeugen. Entscheidend ist: Du hast eine verteilte Flotte am Laufen gehalten – Verfügbarkeit, Reparaturzeiten, Kosten – und dafür Team und Partnernetz aufgebaut. Was du mitbringst Einen technischen Hintergrund, z. B. eine technische Ausbildung oder ein technisches Studium oder praktische Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Wartung und Reparatur. 5+ Jahre Erfahrung in der Steuerung einer verteilten Flotte oder technischen Außendienst-Organisation, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Umfeld. Erfahrung in der Führung von Führungskräften und im Arbeiten in einer Matrix. Du hast schon mal etwas aufgebaut oder skaliert – ein Team, einen Prozess, ein Partnernetz. Du kommunizierst klar und direkt und nimmst Teams und Stakeholder mit. Du bist bereit, regelmäßig zu unseren Stationen und Partnern in DACH zu reisen. Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch. title: Regional Sales Manager, DACH (m/w/d)
description: Regional Sales Manager, DACH (m/w/d) Regional Role · Remote, based in the DACH region · Reports to: Sales Director About Everfield Everfield acquires and builds vertical SaaS businesses across Europe. Our portfolio spans more than 40 companies serving niche markets where software is mission-critical. We take a long-term ownership approach: we buy, invest, and build. We don't flip. Seven companies are in DACH, and we expect continuous growth in portfolio size and performance across all regions. We are building a small, high-impact HQ revenue team responsible for lifting the commercial capability of our portfolio companies: setting standards, identifying risk, and accelerating performance. The role reports to Everfield's Sales Director, who owns consistency of the revenue system across all regions, and works day to day with the region's General Director and the CEOs of its Business Units. The Opportunity The Regional Sales Manager (RSM) is a cluster-level revenue operator responsible for improving sales execution and accelerating organic revenue growth across a group of portfolio companies. The role partners directly with CEOs and Business Unit leaders to strengthen pipeline discipline, improve forecast accuracy, and raise commercial maturity across the region. This is not purely an advisory role. Alongside the regional remit, the RSM is expected to take direct sales management responsibility inside Business Units where that is the fastest route to growth, giving smaller commercial teams access to experienced sales leadership they would not otherwise have. As the region scales, the ambition is that one person can hold the sales management role on behalf of several Business Units at once, applying a standard across all of them. Success is reflected in improved revenue predictability, stronger pipeline discipline, and sustained bookings growth across Business Units. How the Role Operates • Two levels, one standard. The regional remit is constant: diagnostics, pipeline discipline, forecast integrity, and commercial governance across every Business Unit in the cluster. Beyond it, the role flexes. In some Business Units you will coach and support an existing sales manager. In others you will hold the sales management role yourself. • Direct team leadership where it is needed. Where you act as sales manager, you own the team, the pipeline, the forecast, and the number, in the same way a local sales manager would, and you report into that Business Unit's CEO for delivery while remaining accountable to Everfield for how the work is done. • You are not a seller. You do not carry a personal quota and you are not measured on deals you close yourself. You are measured on what the teams you lead and support deliver. • Reporting. You report to Everfield's Sales Director for standards, priorities, and development. The role is a shared resource for the region rather than a function serving any single Business Unit, acting in close partnership with Group Directors, CEOs, and sales teams. What You Will Do Sales Execution & Commercial Acceleration • Drive new and expansion bookings growth across the cluster, with consistent attention to prospecting, opportunity development, and account growth. • Act as sales manager for one or more Business Units: run the weekly rhythm, set priorities, coach the team, and hold sellers to their number. • Reduce volatility in bookings performance and increase revenue consistency across the cluster. • Strengthen proactive sales behaviour across outbound, account expansion, renewals and opportunity reactivation. • Improve sales execution across the full funnel, from lead generation through to closing and account retention. • Embed sales methodology and qualification standards, and hold teams to them through evidence rather than instruction. • Lead deal/pipeline reviews and targeted coaching to improve win rates, shorten cycle times, and build seller capability. Pipeline Discipline & Forecast Integrity • Improve forecast reliability across Business Units, working toward 5% variance or better. • Define and apply opportunity qualification standards and run structured pipeline reviews. • Ensure pipeline visibility reflects realistic execution capacity, and raise revenue risks early to Business Units and Everfield leadership, always paired with a recommended course of action rather than an open flag. • Monitor sustained underperformance patterns and ensure corrective action plans are implemented in time to matter. Revenue Standards & Definitions • Act as guardian of Everfield's revenue definitions in the region: what counts as a booking, how new name is separated from back to base, how recurring value is recognised, and what enters the pipeline in the first place. • Hold those definitions consistently, including where a Business Unit's own commercial logic pushes against them, and fix the incentive, target, or CRM design underneath rather than bending the measurement. • Make the cluster comparable to every other region, so performance can be read the same way across the portfolio. Commercial Governance • Ensure transparency in quota design, attainment measurement, and sales capacity planning. • Support commission structure alignment with business goals. • Contribute to annual, quarterly, and monthly commercial planning by reality-checking growth assumptions against pipeline health, execution capacity, and historical feasibility. Commercial Diagnostics • Diagnose revenue performance across segments, teams, and funnel stages, identifying where revenue is generated, stalled, or lost. • Produce a written diagnostic and prioritised action plan for each Business Unit you take on, naming the problem, the cause, the cost of inaction, the action, the owner, and the date. • Prioritise your own time across the cluster on distance to target, materiality to the region, and whether a documented plan already exists. • Provide feedback on pricing discipline, discounting practices, packaging effectiveness, and ICP conversion efficiency. • Translate performance signals into executive-level recommendations and commercial action plans. CEO & General Director Partnership • Act as strategic commercial partner to CEOs and Business Unit leaders, representing Everfield's revenue expectations and performance discipline. • Challenge growth assumptions constructively and escalate persistent underperformance when required. What Success Looks Like In the first 12 months: • Full visibility into the commercial funnel, aligned with HQ reporting standards. • Acceleration of organic recurring revenue growth across the region. • Improved reliability of pipeline data and forecast accuracy. • Sales pipelines that more accurately predict bookings performance. • At least one Business Unit where you hold sales management directly and the team delivers against its number. • Reliable visibility of quota attainment and seller productivity. • Deal reviews embedded across portfolio sales teams, resulting in higher win rates and shorter sales cycles. • Revenue per seller increasing steadily across the cluster. • A documented, reusable set of playbooks and diagnostics that other regions can apply without starting again. What We Are Looking For • 6-10 years total experience in B2B SaaS revenue roles, with at least 3-4 years in a sales management position, accountable for a team's bookings performance and not only for personal pipeline contribution. • Track record of consistent revenue target attainment in a management role. You have owned a number and delivered against it, not only improved process quality. • Direct experience leading and developing a sales team, including hiring, coaching, and managing underperformance. You will do this again here, inside our Business Units. • Track record of implementing structured pipeline management: defining stage criteria, enforcing qualification standards, running deal reviews, and improving forecast reliability. • Experience diagnosing revenue performance across the full funnel: understanding where deals are lost, why cycles extend, and what structural issues limit growth. • Manages through CRM data: uses pipeline data to run structured deal reviews, identify risk, and hold sellers accountable to data quality. Familiar with Salesforce or HubSpot as a management tool. • Experience working with senior stakeholders (CEOs, founders, or general managers) on commercial performance, including navigating organisational resistance and earning trust before driving change. • Experience adapting sales management approach across companies at different sales maturity levels: able to calibrate coaching, process rigour, and expectations to fit the context. • German fluency required, with professional English for work across the group. European B2B SaaS market experience required. • Commercial finance literacy is a strong advantage: reading a P&L, understanding revenue recognition, and being able to argue the return on a commercial investment. • Private-equity-backed or multi-entity SaaS environment experience is a strong advantage. Skills • Structured coaching and seller development: designing and running structured 1:1s, deal reviews, and field accompaniment to build individual seller capability, not just inspect opportunities. • Pipeline discipline and forecasting: reading a pipeline critically, identifying risk early, and improving forecast reliability. • Change management: driving commercial process adoption across multiple teams, and building momentum without relying on formal authority. • Documentation and knowledge scale: writing down what you diagnose and what you implement, in a form another person can pick up and run. Work that lives only in conversation does not scale across a portfolio, and anything you build for one Business Unit should be reusable in the next. • Commercial planning and challenge: building a bottom-up view of what revenue targets are achievable, pressure-testing top-down assumptions, and presenting credible alternatives to leadership. • Commercial storytelling: presenting clear, honest risk assessments to CEOs and senior leadership, and leading a review that drives decisions rather than just restating numbers. Full Business proficiency in German and English is a must Who You Are • You lead teams and you influence without authority. You will manage sellers directly in some Business Units and hold no formal authority in others. Both need to work. You build trust quickly and drive change through credibility, clarity, and structured analysis. • You are hands-on with sales execution. You are comfortable stepping into real deals, reviewing opportunities with sellers, and diagnosing pipeline issues directly with the team, without needing to be the person closing. • You combine analytical thinking with practical commercial judgement. You interpret pipeline data, and you also understand the realities of getting deals done. • You communicate clearly and directly. You raise commercial risks early, with a recommendation attached, and challenge assumptions constructively, including when performance doesn't meet expectations. You are pragmatic in complex environments. Portfolio companies vary in maturity and commercial model. You bring discipline without imposing rigid process that doesn't fit the situation Hiring Processs: TA screen (30min) Hiring Manager interview (90min) Group Director interview Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow
