About Black Forest Labs

We're the team behind Latent Diffusion, Stable Diffusion, and FLUX—foundational technologies that changed how the world creates images and video. We're creating the generative models that power how people make images and video—tools used by millions of creators, developers, and businesses worldwide. Our FLUX models are among the most advanced in the world, and we're just getting started.

Headquartered in Freiburg, Germany with a growing presence in San Francisco, we're scaling fast while staying true to what makes us different: research excellence, open science, and building technology that expands human creativity.

Why this role

FLUX models ship as open weights, which gives anyone full access to the model. Our safety efforts focus on suppressing harmful behaviors and mitigating the risk of misuse, so safety has to be built into the models themselves, not bolted on afterwards.

As a Member of Technical Staff on our safety research team, you'll research and ship methods that make FLUX models safe by design: from what goes into the training data to how the models are mid- and post-trained, across images, video and the text that conditions them. This is a role with real ownership: you won't just do research on model safety, you'll shape it. The methods you build ship in FLUX models with over 75 million downloads on Hugging Face and in production at some of the largest platforms in the world.

What you'll work on

  • Develop mid- and post-training safety methods for FLUX models, such as safety SFT, preference optimization and RL with safety rewards, and concept erasure.

  • Build safety data filtering that runs at pretraining scale: classifiers and pipelines that screen billions of images, video clips and captions, with measured Pareto frontiers and precision/recall trade-offs.

  • Make safety hold up for open-weight releases, including robustness to adversarial prompts and to downstream fine-tuning.

  • Extend safety to the text side of the stack: prompts, captions and the text encoders that condition our models.

  • Design evaluations and red-teaming that measure harmful generations alongside image quality and prompt following, so safety gains don't come at the cost of performance.

  • Work directly with pretraining and post-training teams so your methods land in the release model, and publish where it makes sense.

What we're looking for

  • Hands-on research experience in visual safety: safety of text-to-image, text-to-video or vision-language models, such as harm classifiers, safe generation methods or safety benchmarks.

  • Proven experience in at least one of:

    • Large-scale safety data filtering: building and running classifiers or filtering pipelines over hundreds of millions of samples or more.

    • Safety mid- or post-training: safety SFT, DPO or RL with safety objectives, or unlearning applied to large generative models.

  • Deep familiarity with concept erasure methods (e.g. ESD, UCE, adversarial unlearning) and their failure modes, such as concept recovery and collateral damage to unrelated concepts.

  • Track record of shipping: top-venue publications (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ICCV, ECCV) paired with production impact, or unambiguous production wins at a frontier lab.

  • Experience with distributed training at multi-node scale.

  • Strong PyTorch fluency; you write research code that others can build on. You work fluently with coding agents to move faster, and have the depth to verify their output and own the result.

  • Experience running multi-agent workflows: you know which tasks to hand off and which to keep yourself, and you use the speed-up to raise the quality bar, not lower it.

We'd be especially excited if you:

  • Know how to keep safety intact after release, when others fine-tune open weights.

  • Have tackled safety for video generation, where harm can emerge across frames rather than in any single frame.

  • Bring experience with audio safety, especially for jointly generated audio and video, where each modality can amplify harm in the other.

  • Have unlearned concepts from text encoders or built safety-tuned encoders (e.g. Safe-CLIP-style approaches).

  • Have worked on text safety: LLM safety tuning, prompt and jailbreak defenses, or text safety classifiers, ideally across languages.

  • Have applied latent-space safety methods, such as activation steering or safe guidance.

  • Have built VLM-based safety judges or guard models for filtering or evaluation.

How we work together

We're a distributed team with real offices that people actually use. You'll join us in Freiburg at least 2 days a week (or one full week every other week). We'll cover reasonable travel costs to make this possible. We think in-person time matters, and we've structured things to make it accessible to all. We'll discuss what this will look like for the role during our interview process.

Everything we do is grounded in four values:

  • Obsessed. We are a frontier research lab. The science has to be right, the understanding deep, the product beautiful.

  • Low Ego. The work speaks. The best idea wins, no matter who said it. Credit is shared. Nobody is above any task.

  • Bold. We take the ambitious bet. We ship, we do not wait for conditions to be perfect.

  • Kind. People over politics. We treat each other with genuine warmth. Agency without empathy creates chaos.

If this sounds like work you'd enjoy, we'd love to hear from you.

EUR 160K-220K + equity, depending on profile

You are the architect of the network that our GPU clusters run on. This is not an architecture-only role. We are a small team moving fast, and the right person is as comfortable writing a port map, tracing a bad optic, or tuning congestion control on the data center floor as they are setting technical direction.

  • Own the fabric architecture for every site: GPU backend fabric (InfiniBand and/or RoCEv2), and GPU frontend Fabric

  • Debug fabric problems wherever they show up, from a flapping link to a job that’s mysteriously slow

  • Evaluate and select AI Fabric vendors and hardware, and push back with data when something doesn’t meet spec

  • Collaborate across automation and software to help build network monitoring, telemetry, and automation that let a small team run a large fleet, and be the top escalation point for AI Fabric incidents

  • A track record of taking GPU fabrics from empty racks to production, with your own hands on the work, not only through vendors or integrators

  • Experience with NVLink / NVL72-class rack-scale systems and how they change scale-out fabric design

  • Experience with GPUDirect RDMA and GPUDirect Storage networks

Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based at our Oxford, England (UK) office, with the option to work a few days a week remotely.<br><strong>Travel:</strong> Up to 5%<strong><br>Job ID:</strong> 1830</p> <p><strong>The Role:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a senior Systems Software Engineer to join our Runtime Software team at Oxford Ionics / IonQ. In this role, you will be responsible for working directly with the experimental scientists to implement the real-time control system behaviours and provide abstractions they require for their experiments, contributing to the team’s mission of enabling our science teams to experiment and improve the primitive operations which allow compute, and building towards fault tolerant computation.</p> <p>You’ll play an important part in shaping the core, Rust, libraries and the execution environment which take our system from a collection of hardware to a quantum computer, and support our work in building the world’s most advanced quantum systems.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong>:</p> <p>In this position, you will work on developing abstractions over real-time control hardware, supporting the effective delivery of a control system capable of repeatedly and reproducibly driving our ions with nano-second level precision, with abstractions which are conducive to both fast iteration and system scaling.</p> <p>You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate the science core to the development of our systems, and contribute to the core execution model of our quantum computers, contributing directly to the success of building utility-scale quantum computers.</p> <p>Key responsibilities include:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Collaborating with scientists to understand their requirements</li> <li>Interfacing with system orchestration, non-realtime control and compiler teams to ensure our work integrates seamlessly with the wider software architecture.</li> <li>Interfacing with FPGA and electronics teams to shape the overall system architecture.</li> <li>Implementing drivers for various real-time devices.</li> <li>Producing tooling to enable users of our code to iterate rapidly and fearlessly.</li> <li>Developing the execution environment for the user programs which run on our systems.</li> <li>Continually evaluating the shape of our APIs and improving them for our internal users.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Requirements:</strong></p> <p>To be successful, you will need strong programming skills in a systems programming language, experience with software system design, and a desire to produce high quality code appropriate to a real-time environment. We’re looking for someone who can quickly iterate on low-level code in a collaborative, cross-disciplinary, environment and contribute effectively within a fast moving, highly technical team.</p> <ul> <li>Have strong programming skills in one or more mainstream programming languages</li> <li>Have experience with a systems programming programming</li> <li>Have experience with real-time linux or embedded systems or another low-latency computing environment</li> <li>Have an interest in or experience with Rust</li> <li>Have developed excellent communication skills both within the context of software and across disciplines</li> <li>Are comfortable working with rapidly evolving requirements</li> <li>Are used to maintaining and producing high quality code reviews and appropriate testing</li> <li>Have a desire to maximise impact through quick iteration and short cycles of learning and improvement</li> <li>Are eager to learn and develop your skills</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.&nbsp;</p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br>&nbsp;<br>We are committed to equity and justice. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.&nbsp; Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.&nbsp; Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.&nbsp; Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong>&nbsp;Oxford, UK<br><strong>Office commitment:</strong> Hybrid</p> <p><strong>The Role:</strong></p> <p>Quantum is now, and it's built here. Previous exposure to quantum systems is not required.</p> <p>You will take on our most demanding hardware integrations and the framework work that makes every other controller better. This is a hands-on engineering role: you would be the most experienced engineer writing controllers, not the one directing others to write them.</p> <p>A working quantum computer is far more than the ion trap and its real-time control electronics. Our controllers are written in Rust, so either solid Rust experience or deep proficiency in another systems language and the appetite to work in a Rust codebase, including async programming.</li> <li>Experience building and operating networked services in production such as gRPC or REST, with a real grasp of error handling, observability and failure modes.</li> <li>Experience of hardware and instrument protocols and interfaces such as SCPI, Modbus, serial and Ethernet.</li> <li>A reputation as the person people bring the undiagnosable bug to, and the ability to prioritise work with a clear understanding of critical versus urgent items.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills both within software and across disciplines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Be part of a team that’s shaping the future of quantum. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.&nbsp; Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.&nbsp; Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.&nbsp; Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

AI is changing what it means to deploy enterprise software. Configuring a customer's procurement workflows used to mean weeks of manual setup, integration by integration, edge case by edge case. Increasingly, that first-draft build work can be directed rather than done by hand: AI agents can generate workflow configurations, draft integration mappings, and produce the initial pass on a customer's setup.

The job shifts with it. Instead of building every workflow yourself, you specify exactly what needs to exist, direct AI to build it, and apply the judgment AI can't: is this the right configuration for this customer's approval policy, will Legal and Finance actually sign off on it, does it hold up once real spend starts flowing through it. In practice, that might mean catching that the approval chain AI just drafted works perfectly for HQ, but misses a regional delegation-of-authority rule that would fail an audit in the customer's APAC entity.

As Omnea's AI Solutions Lead, you own deployment of the Omnea platform end to end - typically running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently - for some of Europe's most recognisable companies. You advise customers on the best-fit configuration, direct AI-assisted build work to get there fast, and validate every output against what the customer actually needs. You'll also deal with the politics that come with every enterprise rollout: the Legal team wanting one more sign-off, the Finance stakeholder who doesn't trust the new approval flow, the exec sponsor who's gone quiet. You become the internal voice of the customer, and you're judged on outcomes you can point to: time to launch, post-go-live CSAT, and whether that customer becomes a case study or reference.

This is an early hire on Omnea's customer team, working directly with our sales, customer, product, and engineering leadership. The future shape of the role is yours to define!

What You'll Do

Discover and design

  • Run discovery with customer stakeholders across Procurement, Finance, Legal, and IT, and translate their process into an Omnea configuration

  • Design the target workflow: approval chains, routing logic, integrations, and the edge cases that make procurement hard

  • On a deployment with a dozen-plus integrations, you own the sequencing - what has to land first, what blocks what - and the harder calls underneath it: which system is the source of truth for a given entity, and how records reconcile when two systems key that entity differently

  • Define success criteria and a realistic path to go-live with the customer's project sponsor

Build with AI, not instead of it

  • You're not just directing AI to draft your own deliverables faster - you're configuring the specialized agents Omnea's customers rely on every day: an intake agent that knows how to ask a procurement analyst the right follow-up question, a risk agent that flags what actually matters to this customer's Legal team

  • The real leverage comes from chaining agents together - an intake agent that hands clean, structured requests to a risk agent, which in turn routes into approvals with the right context already attached. You design how those agents work as a system, not just individually

  • Writing a spec for one agent is a skill. Writing one that holds up across a chain of agents - where one agent's output becomes another's input - is the actual bar here

  • Validate every AI-generated output against the customer's actual process, policy, and edge cases before anything ships

  • Handle what AI can't: judgment calls on ambiguous requirements, custom logic, and anything that needs a human read on internal politics

Deploy and prove value

  • Present configured workflows to stakeholders, from procurement analysts to CFOs, working through the pushback and internal politics that come with any enterprise rollout, and win their buy-in

  • Run multi-day onsite workshops with customers, coordinating dozens of stakeholders across multiple workstreams at once - a different muscle than a single stakeholder meeting

  • Project-manage the deployment: timelines, blockers, stakeholder alignment, and a clear path to launch, acting as an extension of the customer's team

  • Track adoption after go-live and keep the configuration working as the customer's process evolves

  • Work with Product and Engineering during the design phase, not just after something breaks in the field - you're often the earliest signal on whether a new module will hold up for an enterprise customer, and that shapes what gets built next

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time specifying and validating than building from scratch. AI produces the first draft; you make sure it's right for this customer

  • Writing instructions AI can act on precisely is a skill you'll build fast here. Vague requests produce vague configurations

  • Judgment matters more, not less. AI speeds up the build, but you decide whether the output is right for this contract, this Board, this customer

  • You'll keep experimenting as our AI tooling evolves, and share what works with the rest of the team

About You

We don't expect you to know how to do all of this on day one. TL;DR: you're ambitious and hard-working, as comfortable directing an AI agent through a tricky configuration as you are presenting a project plan to an exec. You make up for any gap in experience with hunger and a genuine growth mindset. You derive energy from building relationships, shipping projects, and making customers succeed.

  • 4-8 years in a fast-paced, high-bar environment: a startup, scale-up, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself

    • Less experience? Check out our Solutions Associate role

  • Comfortable directing AI tools to produce first-draft work, and confident enough in your own judgment to catch what's wrong. Prior use of tools like ChatGPT, Claude, or Cursor is a strong plus. What matters most is your ability to write clear, specific instructions and evaluate what comes back

  • Client-facing experience, or the natural gravitas to be excellent at it. You can point to a time you went well beyond what a client expected

  • A track record of doing something exceptionally well, whether that's work, academia, sport, or anything else you've put your mind to

  • Comfortable reasoning about system architecture - how data models, primary keys, and integration sequencing interact across a dozen enterprise systems. You don't need to write the integration code, but you need to know why it breaks and be able to reason with the people who do, and you'll need to become an Omnea product expert

  • You build real relationships with people at any level, from a junior procurement analyst to a CFO, and know how to handle pushback and stakeholder politics, not just build rapport

  • Comfortable running rooms of stakeholders across a genuinely cross-functional tool - on a single project you'll interface with the CPO, Legal, Finance, AP, InfoSec, and Compliance, plus each of their technical resources, often all with competing priorities on the same decision

  • Comfortable moving between the detail and the big picture: configuring a workflow in the morning, presenting a project plan to an exec in the afternoon

  • Entrepreneurial, have high ownership, and want to be part of building something. We've signed up to the Future Founder Promise

  • An excellent communicator: clear and concise, verbal and written, even when the subject is complicated

  • Highly organised: comfortable running 3-5 enterprise deployments concurrently, each at a different stage, without dropping any of them

About the Role

Callosum believes that orders of magnitude improvements in AI systems will come through application-aware orchestration across heterogeneous models and hardware. The General Capabilities team is developing the science that makes that possible: a principled, evidence-based method for building agentic systems automatically.

We are hiring for several positions on this team through one application. Depending on your background, you will work on our agent runtime, on evaluation, or on automated agentic system optimisation. title: Senior Partner Account Manager - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div><p><strong>Senior Partner Account Manager - EMEA&nbsp;</strong><br>Location: EMEA (London, in office)<br>Experience: 8–12 years<br>Travel: 50%+<br>Reports To: Director, SI Partnerships<br>Focus: Strategic channel management and geo expansion</p> <p><br>The Sigma Partnerships team is hiring a Senior Partner Account Manager in our London office to support&nbsp;Sigma's continued growth across EMEA. This role will strategically own a portfolio of System Integrator (SI)&nbsp;Partners and will report to GTM leadership within the partner team. This role will drive the growth and&nbsp;success of Sigma across EMEA and collaborate closely with sales and marketing teams to ensure success.</p> <p>Sigma's SI partner ecosystem is growing rapidly, both globally and in the region, to meet rising demand for&nbsp;professional services around Sigma and the Modern Data Stack. The ideal candidate brings a proven track&nbsp;record managing partners, an established network of partner contacts across the EMEA data space, and&nbsp;comfort operating in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.</p> <p><strong>What you will be doing</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Partner Management:</strong> Design and execute GTM activities for a portfolio of SI partners across EMEA, growing both partner-sourced ACV and services revenue for our partners.</li> <li><strong>Field Alignment: </strong>Work directly with the sales team to coordinate co-selling between partners and&nbsp;Sigma throughout sales cycles, and to recommend partners for services engagements at Sigma&nbsp;customers.</li> <li><strong>Relationship Management:</strong> Build and maintain strong relationships with SI partner executives and employees through regular communication, joint marketing and sales campaigns, and prompt resolution of partner issues and concerns.</li> <li><strong>In-Market Presence: </strong>Represent Sigma at industry events across EMEA to strengthen our brand equity. Partner closely with the Field Marketing team to run events and meet with prospects, customers, and&nbsp;partners to share Sigma’s vision.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of partner management experience in enterprise SaaS, or equivalent experience leading at a professional services organization</li> <li>Strong sales instincts and genuine curiosity, always digging deeper to find new ways to partner&nbsp;effectively and differentiate Sigma to generate new opportunities</li> <li>A collaborative team player with a track record of supporting, working with, and winning alongside both&nbsp;internal and external teams</li> <li>Deep experience building executive relationships within partner organizations</li> <li>Genuine interest in the Modern Data Stack and cloud ecosystem</li> <li>Flexible and dynamic, with a builder's mentality suited to a fast-paced, start-up environment</li> <li>Willingness to travel 50%+ within the region, with occasional global travel for events and conferences</li> </ul> <p><br><strong>Preferred Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Knowledge of and experience in the BI/analytics software industry</li> <li>Familiarity with the Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, and Google BigQuery partner ecosystems</li> <li>Experience standing up reseller partnerships in addition to co-sell motions</li> <li>Experience using Sigma, Salesforce, Crossbeam, and Gong in partner contexts</li> <li>Sales at or professional services/consulting experience, particularly at a Global System Integrator with&nbsp;an established EMEA presence</li> <li>Fluency in English required; additional languages a plus</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About us:&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Sigma is the AI Apps and agentic analytics platform built on the cloud data warehouse. Business and technical teams use Sigma to explore live data, build intelligent applications, and automate critical workflows all without moving data or breaking governance. Sigma supports a spreadsheet interface, SQL, Python, and native AI in a single governed workspace, giving every team the speed to act and IT the control to scale. Sigma is trusted by more than 2,000 customers, including AMD, Duolingo, Colgate-Palmolive, and JPMorgan Chase.&nbsp;</p> <p>Sigma announced its $80M in Series E financing in May 2026. The round was led by Princeville Capital, with new strategic investors Databricks Ventures, ServiceNow Ventures, and Workday Ventures participating alongside returning investors Altimeter Capital, Avenir Growth Capital, D1 Capital Partners, K5 Global, NewView Capital, Spark Capital, Sutter Hill Ventures, and XN. This milestone follows Sigma reaching $200M in annual recurring revenue in April 2026, with more than 100% year-over-year growth and 1.1 million new active users added in the latest fiscal year.</p> <p>Come join us!</p> <h4>Benefits For Our Full-Time Employees:</h4> <ul> <li>Equity&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Generous health benefits</li> <li>Flexible time off policy. Take the time off you need!</li> <li>Paid bonding time for all new parents</li> <li>Traditional and Roth 401k</li> <li>Commuter and FSA benefits</li> <li>Lunch Program</li> <li>Dog friendly office</li> </ul> <p>Sigma is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a smart and strong team regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, veteran, or any other protected status. We look forward to learning how your experience can enable all of us to grow.</p> <p><em><strong>Note: </strong>We have an in-office work environment in all our offices in SF, NYC, London and Sydney. All roles have a 25% travel expectation unless explicitly stated otherwise.</em></p> <p><strong>Our Privacy Practices</strong></p> <p>When you submit a job application on this site, Sigma processes your personal data for the purposes of evaluating your candidacy for employment at Sigma and as otherwise needed throughout the recruitment and hiring process. Please review Sigma’s <a href="https://www.sigmacomputing.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice">Candidate Privacy Notice</a> for more details. Please note that your personal data may be transferred to a country other than the one in which it was provided (including to the USA, the UK, and Canada, Australia).&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Sigma’s use of AI</strong></p> <p>This hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Financial Services Insurance practice are looking for experienced Senior Managers and Directors to join our Specialty Insurance team.</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <p><span data-contrast="none">Our team works with leading insurers and London Market organisations to solve complex strategic and transformation challenges. We combine deep insurance expertise with business architecture, operating model design, data, digital, AI and technology capabilities to help clients transform underwriting, claims, operations and finance.</span> <span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335557856&quot;:16777215,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We are particularly interested in individuals who bring strong expertise in Data, Digital &amp; AI Transformation or Business solution Architecture &amp; Industry SME knowledge delivering complex change. Candidates are not expected to specialise in both areas.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335557856&quot;:16777215,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">At Senior Manager level:</span></strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Lead complex Specialty Insurance transformation programmes, bringing expertise in data, digital, AI or business solution architecture/operating model transformation.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Work with senior client stakeholders to define strategies, design practical solutions and deliver measurable outcomes across underwriting, claims, operations and finance.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead multidisciplinary teams across business and technology, managing delivery, governance, risks and dependencies.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Apply specialist knowledge to deliver either data and AI strategies, automation solutions, target operating models, business process redesign or wider technology-enabled transformation.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Build trusted client relationships, contribute to proposals and business development, and support the growth of our Specialty Insurance capabilities.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">At Director level:</span></strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Shape and lead our Specialty Insurance transformation propositions, with a particular focus on Data, Digital &amp; AI and technology-enabled business change.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Originate, shape and sell large-scale transformation programmes, building relationships with executive and C-suite stakeholders across the London Market and Specialty Insurance sector.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Provide strategic advisory leadership across either data and AI strategy, business architecture, operating model transformation and complex business change.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Lead strategic accounts and multidisciplinary programmes, taking accountability for commercial performance, client relationships and delivery outcomes.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Drive proposition development, go-to-market activity and capability building, developing high-performing teams and strengthening Baringa's market presence.&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">&nbsp;</span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span>&nbsp;</span><br><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></h3> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">At Senior Manager level:</span></strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Strong experience within Specialty Insurance, the London Market or insurance consulting, with functional knowledge across underwriting, claims, operations or finance.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrable expertise in <strong>at least one of our priority areas</strong>: Data, Digital &amp; AI (including data strategy, governance, GenAI, automation and technology transformation) or Business Architecture &amp; Transformation (including target operating models, capability modelling, process redesign and organisational change).&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven experience leading complex transformation programmes, multidisciplinary teams and senior stakeholder relationships.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Ability to translate strategic and technical challenges into practical business solutions, working effectively across business and technology functions.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Commercial awareness and experience contributing to client relationships, proposals, proposition development and business development.&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:true,&quot;134233118&quot;:true,&quot;201341983&quot;:2,&quot;335559685&quot;:1320,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">At Director level:</span></strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>Significant senior leadership experience within Specialty Insurance, the London Market or insurance consulting, with established market credibility and executive relationships.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Deep expertise in Data, Digital &amp; AI transformation or business architecture and operating model change, with the ability to shape and lead complex insurance transformation agendas.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrable track record of originating, shaping and selling large-scale consulting or transformation engagements, alongside strategic account management and commercial growth.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong experience advising executive and C-suite stakeholders, translating emerging technology and business transformation opportunities into compelling client propositions.&nbsp;</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven leadership of multidisciplinary teams, proposition development, capability building and talent development.&nbsp;</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span>&nbsp;</span></h2> <h3><br><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Digital risk, cyber security and resilience are no longer cost centres - they are where value is won or lost.&nbsp;</span></span></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The Jaguar Land Rover cyber attack cost the company £196m and had a £1.9bn impact on the UK economy. The damage wasn't a data breach, it was an attack on the connected technology that runs the business. We protect the things which underpin our daily lives: energy, water, payments, banking, hospitals and critical public services – and the supply chains behind them.</p> <p>We don't just advise clients; we design, build and stand up the frameworks, operating models and tooling that keep working long after we leave.</p> <p>We're a specialist team scaling fast, and we're independent by design: no software to resell, no audit relationship to protect, so nothing shapes our advice except the problem in front of you.</p> <p>We work in small, senior teams – so you own real client relationships and real commercial outcomes from day one. We're looking for Senior Managers who want to be the name clients ask for and the market knows. This is a role for people who want to win and deliver work while they build a practice: originating opportunities, leading complex engagements, and growing the reputations – theirs and ours – that open the next door.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) practice is scaling fast, and we're looking for experienced consultants who want to build and solve, not just advise&nbsp;</span></span></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) team helps clients secure the things that matter most – from their overall security strategy and operating model, to the specific technologies that drive value in their business. Our work is organised around two specialisms:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Digital Resilience:</strong> helping clients meet fast-moving security, resilience and regulatory obligations such as the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF), the EU’s Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and EU AI Act, and the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill.</li> <li><strong>Digital Trust: </strong>helping clients govern emerging technology and security risk, including AI, cloud and post-quantum cryptography.</li> </ul> <p>We also build security into our clients' biggest change and transformation programmes, and run the regulatory and standards compliance work that underpins their operations.</p> <p>We are independent by design. With no software to resell and no audit relationship to protect, our people can give a genuinely honest view – and be trusted advisors in the truest sense.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <ul> <li data-leveltext="" data-font="Symbol" data-listid="34" description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>As a Senior Manager in our Commodities &amp; Energy Trading practice, you will help clients navigate changing commodity markets by combining trading expertise with the practical application of data, analytics and AI.</p> <p>You will play a key role in shaping and delivering our commodity and energy trading proposition: leading client engagements, developing new opportunities and showing clients where AI and advanced analytics can create genuine commercial value.</p> <p>You are likely to bring deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with some understanding or practical exposure to the other. You will work alongside specialists from both disciplines, building on your core expertise while continuing to deepen your capabilities across the intersection of trading and AI. The aim is to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, measurable improvements in how trading businesses operate.</p> <p><strong>AI &amp; Trading Transformation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Shape propositions at the intersection of commodity trading, AI and digital transformation, and bring market insight on how AI is changing trading organisations, business models and competitive dynamics</li> <li>Translate real trading problems into practical GenAI and agentic use cases that deliver value to clients</li> <li>Advise clients on where AI should augment human decision-making, where workflows can be automated, and where human judgement remains critical</li> <li>Design trading journeys from opportunity identification and experimentation through to scaled adoption, with the metrics and value cases that show impact on performance, productivity, risk and profitability</li> <li>Work with traders, portfolio managers, data scientists and technology teams to turn concepts into solutions that operate in live trading environments</li> <li>Drive adoption of GenAI copilots, agents and intelligent workflows that improve trader productivity and decision quality</li> <li>Establish governance, model risk, human oversight and responsible-use approaches without losing sight of commercial outcomes</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Commodities &amp; Energy Trading</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Advise on front-to-back trading processes, from market intelligence and trade origination through execution, scheduling, settlement and risk management across commodities including Power, Oil &amp; Refined Products, Natural Gas, LNG, Metals, Renewables and Environmental Products</li> <li>Support clients in evolving their trading strategies, operating models and capabilities in response to changing markets and new technologies</li> <li>Bring an understanding of market structure, pricing, forecasting, physical flows and the commercial decisions that drive trading performance</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span>&nbsp;</span><br><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>We are looking for an experienced professional with 8-12+ years of relevant experience and a strong background in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI. The strongest candidates will combine meaningful experience across both areas. However, we also welcome applicants who bring deep expertise in one discipline alongside a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other.</p> <p>You might be a commodities and trading specialist who has applied data, analytics or AI to trading decisions, processes or transformation, or a data and AI practitioner who has worked in, or gained exposure to, commodities, energy or another trading environment.</p> <p>You do not need equal depth in both disciplines, but you should be able to demonstrate a genuine foundation in each and a clear motivation to deepen your experience at their intersection.</p> <p><strong>What we look for in everyone</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong commercial judgement and the ability to engage credibly with senior trading and executive stakeholders</li> <li>The ability to distinguish genuinely valuable AI opportunities from technology-led experimentation</li> <li>Experience contributing to or leading complex transformation, strategy or operating-model engagements</li> <li>Strong leadership, communication and team-development skills</li> <li>Deep expertise in either commodities and energy trading or data, analytics and AI, together with a working understanding of, or some practical exposure to, the other discipline and the commitment to continue building depth across both</li> </ul> <p><strong>If your primary background is in commodities and trading, you will ideally bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in at least one commodity, such as Power, Gas, LNG, Oil, Metals or Environmental Products</li> <li>A strong understanding of trading, portfolio management, risk, physical flows, scheduling, optimisation and/or commercial operations</li> <li>Familiarity with ETRM/CTRM platforms and the wider trading technology and data ecosystems</li> <li>Some experience of using, sponsoring or shaping data, analytics, automation or AI initiatives within a trading or commercial environment, together with an understanding of how these capabilities can improve trading decisions, processes and outcomes</li> </ul> <p><strong>If your primary background is in data, analytics and AI, you will ideally bring</strong></p> <ul> <li>Practical experience identifying, shaping or delivering AI, GenAI, machine learning or intelligent automation use cases</li> <li>An understanding of the opportunities and limitations of GenAI, LLMs, AI agents and decision-support tools, and how they apply in a trading environment</li> <li>Some experience of commodities, energy, financial markets or trading With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a&nbsp;<em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Digital risk, cyber security and resilience are no longer cost centres – they are where value is won or lost</span></span></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The Jaguar Land Rover cyber attack cost the company £196m and had a £1.9bn impact on the UK economy. The damage wasn't a data breach, it was an attack on the connected technology that runs the business. We protect the things which underpin our daily lives: energy, water, payments, banking, hospitals and critical public services – and the supply chains behind them.</p> <p>We don't just advise clients; we design, build and stand up the frameworks, operating models and tooling that keep working long after we leave.</p> <p>We're a specialist team scaling fast, and we're independent by design: no software to resell, no audit relationship to protect, so nothing shapes our advice except the problem in front of you.</p> <p>We work in small teams of experienced consultants, so everyone has a voice. Quarterly promotion cycles and no quotas mean you are promoted when you are ready, not when a slot opens up.</p> <p>We're looking for Consultants and Senior Consultants who want to be known for tackling our clients’ toughest problems in digital risk, security and resilience.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Digital Risk and Cyber practice is scaling fast, and we're looking for experienced Consultants who want to build and solve, not just advise</span></span></h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Our Digital Risk and Cyber (DRC) team helps clients secure the things that matter most – from their&nbsp;overall security strategy and operating model, to the specific technologies that drive value in their business. Our work is organised around two specialisms:</p> <p>Digital Resilience: helping clients meet fast-moving security, resilience and regulatory obligations such as the Cyber Assessment Framework (CAF), the EU’s Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and EU AI Act, and the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill.</p> <p>Digital Trust: helping clients govern emerging technology and security risk, including AI, cloud and post-quantum cryptography.</p> <p>We also build security into our clients' biggest change and transformation programmes, and run the regulatory and standards compliance work that underpins their operations.</p> <p>We are independent by design. With no software to resell and no audit relationship to protect, our people can give a genuinely honest view – and be trusted advisors in the truest sense.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the work:</strong> Take personal ownership of high-quality deliverables on complex engagements – shaping the approach, managing workstreams and making sure what we produce has real impact for the client.</li> <li><strong>Go deep: </strong>Build genuine depth in a specialism you care about, and become the go-to expert colleagues and clients rely on to get the hardest calls right.</li> <li><strong>Solve, don't just advise: </strong>Design frameworks, build operating models and stand up tooling that clients actually use – using AI to compress high-volume work, so your time is spent on the judgement.</li> <li><strong>Be the critical friend: </strong>Advise CISOs and their teams directly across financial services, energy, government and critical national infrastructure – balancing technical depth, commercial understanding and the relationships that make advice land.</li> <li><strong>Help build the business:</strong> Grow your network and profile, contribute to new and evolving propositions, put yourself forward for the right opportunities, and spot ways to create more value for clients.</li> <li><strong>Grow – and grow others:</strong> Own your development, and support and coach the people around you to be at their best.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>We care more about the shape of your experience than a checklist. If most of the following sound like you, we'd love to hear from you:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Digital risk and cyber experience</strong>: a track record in digital risk, cyber security or resilience, whether gained in consulting or in-house, and a genuine passion for the field.</li> <li><strong>Frameworks and standards:</strong> working knowledge of the standards and frameworks that shape our work, for example NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and the regulatory agenda, for example the EU AI Act, DORA, the UK Cyber Security and Resilience Bill and CAF.</li> <li><strong>Delivery and client craft:</strong> experience delivering in demanding, client-facing environments (programme or project delivery, risk assessments, governance and assurance), with the communication skills to engage anyone from a technology team to the board.</li> <li><strong>Technology and AI literacy:</strong> fluency in, or real curiosity about, using AI to deliver – compressing high-volume work such as regulatory mapping, evidence review and maturity scoring – and advising clients on securing and governing it.</li> <li><strong>Experience in one or more of our domains:</strong> meaningful experience in at least one area we operate in, particularly: OT/ICS security, CAF, AI security and governance, post-quantum and cryptographic agility, operational resilience, strategy and operating model, supply chain risk, security architecture, crisis management and DevSecOps.<span data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:200,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:240}">&nbsp;</span></li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span description: Job Title: People Partner - Paris France Location: Hybrid About Radiant Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built. We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments. We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure - from powered land, to compute, to software . As we scale our platform and expand our engineering organisation, we are looking for leaders who can build strong teams, uphold high standards, and deliver reliably at pace. Job Summary: You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle for our team in France . Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices in line with French employment law across our Paris office and global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale. Key Responsibilities: What you'll do Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, working time and leave (forfait jours, congés payés, RTT) and performance management. Managing employee relations under French law and the applicable convention collective, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on. Serve as the local first line of defence for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to French labour law (Code du travail), the applicable collective bargaining agreement (convention collective), site-specific contracts and health and safety obligations, including keeping the DUERP (workplace risk assessment) up to date. Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive or high-impact situations, monitor recurring issues and operational risks, and ensure that incidents are resolved at their root cause, with appropriate care for the employees involved. Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the Paris office. Draft, review and interpret French employment contracts, amendments (avenants), non-compete clauses with their required financial compensation, and working time arrangements such as forfait jours for cadres. Manage hiring formalities and onboarding under French law, including the DPAE, the registre unique du personnel, the initial occupational health visit (visite d’information et de prévention), and probation periods (périodes d’essai) and their renewal. Support pre-litigation and litigation before the Conseil de prud’hommes, working closely with our external employment lawyers (avocats en droit social). Review, update and maintain Radiant’s French people policies.Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows. Ensure compliance with French employment legislation, collective agreements, internal policies and regulatory requirements. Partner with our external payroll provider on monthly payroll and DSN filings, and manage mandatory benefits, including the mutuelle and prévoyance schemes, and occupational health (médecine du travail) follow-up. Manage training obligations, including the plan de développement des compétences, working with our OPCO, and supporting employees’ use of their CPF (compte personnel de formation). Compliance Help ensure compliance with French employment law and best practice across France and the wider EU, in consultation with the UK-based People team and external French employment counsel as needed. Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet French employment law, GDPR and CNIL requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes. Monitor headcount thresholds (11, 50 and 250 employees) and prepare Radiant for the obligations each one triggers, such as the CSE, the règlement intérieur, gender equality reporting and mandatory profit-sharing (participation). Act as the main point of contact for the labour inspectorate (inspection du travail) and the occupational health service, and keep mandatory registers and workplace notices (affichages obligatoires) up to date. Employee representation (CSE) Set up the CSE once the Paris office reaches 11 employees for 12 consecutive months, including negotiating the protocole d’accord préélectoral and organising professional elections. Run information and consultation processes with the CSE on reorganisations, policy changes and other matters that require it, and set up the BDESE once we reach 50 employees. Build a constructive relationship with employee representatives and prepare for collective bargaining, including the mandatory annual negotiations (NAO) where union delegates are appointed. Immigration and visas Advise on global mobility as we expand across Europe, including UK–France moves, secondments and posted worker (détachement) requirements. Workforce planning Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget. Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale, including the CSE consultation and French legal requirements that apply to any reorganisation. Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions. Performance Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process, alongside the mandatory entretiens professionnels every two years and the six-yearly summary review (état des lieux récapitulatif). Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance (insuffisance professionnelle) through fair, well-documented processes that would stand up before the Conseil de prud’hommes. Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions. Qualifications: 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role in France, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business. Deep, current knowledge of French employment law (Code du travail, conventions collectives, CSE obligations, working time rules) and confidence applying it to real situations. Hands-on experience running disciplinary and dismissal procedures, ruptures conventionnelles and CSE information and consultation processes. Familiarity with French payroll (DSN), mandatory benefits and statutory reporting. Fluent French and strong professional English, written and spoken. A degree in HR or employment law (e.g. Master 2 RH or droit social), or equivalent experience. Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate to external counsel. A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative. Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters, particularly working alongside a UK headquarters, is an advantage. Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency Our values: Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same. Why should you join us? What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive. Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us: 25 days of annual leave A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work. Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together. Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job. Health & Wellbeing: we want everyone to feel healthy and happy, so we offer private medical insurance via Bupa. Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.   • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, working time and leave (forfait jours, congés payés, RTT) and performance management.

  • Managing employee relations under French law and the applicable convention collective, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on.

  • Serve as the local first line of defence for compliance, ensuring strict adherence to French labour law (Code du travail), the applicable collective bargaining agreement (convention collective), site-specific contracts and health and safety obligations, including keeping the DUERP (workplace risk assessment) up to date.

  • Act as an escalation point for complex, sensitive or high-impact situations, monitor recurring issues and operational risks, and ensure that incidents are resolved at their root cause, with appropriate care for the employees involved.

  • Help coordinate and run core HR cycles: performance reviews, compensation planning, and engagement surveys, for the Paris office.

  • Draft, review and interpret French employment contracts, amendments (avenants), non-compete clauses with their required financial compensation, and working time arrangements such as forfait jours for cadres.

  • Manage hiring formalities and onboarding under French law, including the DPAE, the registre unique du personnel, the initial occupational health visit (visite d’information et de prévention), and probation periods (périodes d’essai) and their renewal.

  • Support pre-litigation and litigation before the Conseil de prud’hommes, working closely with our external employment lawyers (avocats en droit social).

  • Review, update and maintain Radiant’s French people policies.Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows.

  • Ensure compliance with French employment legislation, collective agreements, internal policies and regulatory requirements.

  • Partner with our external payroll provider on monthly payroll and DSN filings, and manage mandatory benefits, including the mutuelle and prévoyance schemes, and occupational health (médecine du travail) follow-up.

  • Manage training obligations, including the plan de développement des compétences, working with our OPCO, and supporting employees’ use of their CPF (compte personnel de formation).

Compliance

  • Help ensure compliance with French employment law and best practice across France and the wider EU, in consultation with the UK-based People team and external French employment counsel as needed.

  • Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet French employment law, GDPR and CNIL requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes.

  • Monitor headcount thresholds (11, 50 and 250 employees) and prepare Radiant for the obligations each one triggers, such as the CSE, the règlement intérieur, gender equality reporting and mandatory profit-sharing (participation).

  • Act as the main point of contact for the labour inspectorate (inspection du travail) and the occupational health service, and keep mandatory registers and workplace notices (affichages obligatoires) up to date.

Employee representation (CSE)

  • Set up the CSE once the Paris office reaches 11 employees for 12 consecutive months, including negotiating the protocole d’accord préélectoral and organising professional elections.

  • Run information and consultation processes with the CSE on reorganisations, policy changes and other matters that require it, and set up the BDESE once we reach 50 employees.

  • Build a constructive relationship with employee representatives and prepare for collective bargaining, including the mandatory annual negotiations (NAO) where union delegates are appointed.

Immigration and visas

  • Advise on global mobility as we expand across Europe, including UK–France moves, secondments and posted worker (détachement) requirements.

Workforce planning

  • Partner with leaders to build headcount plans aligned to business priorities and budget.

  • Advise on organisation design, team structures and spans of control as teams scale, including the CSE consultation and French legal requirements that apply to any reorganisation.

  • Use people data from HiBob and Ashby to inform hiring, retention and capacity decisions.

Performance

  • Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process, alongside the mandatory entretiens professionnels every two years and the six-yearly summary review (état des lieux récapitulatif).

  • Support managers to set clear goals, give regular feedback and manage underperformance (insuffisance professionnelle) through fair, well-documented processes that would stand up before the Conseil de prud’hommes.

  • Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions.

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role in France, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business.

  • Deep, current knowledge of French employment law (Code du travail, conventions collectives, CSE obligations, working time rules) and confidence applying it to real situations.

  • Hands-on experience running disciplinary and dismissal procedures, ruptures conventionnelles and CSE information and consultation processes.

  • Familiarity with French payroll (DSN), mandatory benefits and statutory reporting.

  • Fluent French and strong professional English, written and spoken.

  • A degree in HR or employment law (e.g. Master 2 RH or droit social), or equivalent experience.

  • Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate to external counsel.

  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach and a track record of taking initiative.

  • Exposure to multi-jurisdiction employment matters, particularly working alongside a UK headquarters, is an advantage.

  • Strong technical capability and data literacy, and comfort using data and technology to inform decisions and drive efficiency

 

Our values:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up

  • Inspire the change: There’s no blueprint for the future. You’ll embrace challenges and change

  • You’re real and you’re true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you’ll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you’re talking to, you treat everyone the same.

Why should you join us?

What sets us apart is our blend of modern technology, competitive benefits, and an open, welcoming work culture that enables our people to thrive.

Here are just some of the great things you can expect from us:

  • 25 days of annual leave

  • A culture that emphasises results over hierarchy, process & ego: we place great emphasis on the quality, ingenuity and creativity of work.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: we value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and a growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Learning Time: we all have dedicated learning time to focus on new skills, projects or interests that lay outside of your day-to-day job.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme: we're committed to building a sustainable business, so we encourage cycling to work.

  • Participation in the company shares program

  • Enhanced parental pay & leave
