raw.title: Staff AI Engineer - Agent Evaluation Platform (x/f/m)
raw.description:
Join a team of passionate and hardworking entrepreneurs to transform healthcare!

 

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

 

What you'll do

 

We are looking for a Staff AI Software Engineer to join the AI Evaluation team (EvalX) at Doctolib and help every AI product team measure, understand and improve the quality, reliability and safety of their systems.

 

Our AI products span patient-facing conversational agents, AI-powered phone assistants and clinical assistants supporting healthcare professionals. EvalX builds the platform, tools and methods that let these teams evaluate continuously, and our ambition is to make evaluation a core engineering practice.

 

In this role, you will work at the intersection of platform engineering, applied AI and product teams: you build shared evaluation capabilities, and you work directly with the teams that use them so they actually get adopted.

 

In this role, you will:

  • Design, ship, and operate production-grade evaluation tooling (APIs, services, CI/CD integrations) used by AI product teams across Doctolib

  • Work hands-on with product teams to assess how they evaluate today, define improvement plans, and help them own their evaluation quality

  • Design evaluation strategies for agentic systems, combining deterministic checks, LLM-as-a-judge, simulation-based testing, and human review

  • Build intelligent capabilities for production sampling, dataset representativeness monitoring, distribution-shift detection, and test case generation

  • Help teams define meaningful quality metrics, representative datasets, and reliable quality gates throughout the development lifecycle

  • Turn recurring product needs into reusable, self-service platform capabilities, and measure success through adoption, team autonomy, and evaluation coverage

  • Contribute to cross-functional initiatives that shape Doctolib's AI platform and best practices for building and evaluating agentic systems

 

Who you are

 

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply! You could be our next team mate if you:

  • Have 6+ years of experience as a software engineer, with significant experience using Python; or as a machine learning engineer

  • Have built or operated evaluation for LLM-powered or agentic systems: datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, human review, production-driven evaluation

  • Understand and promote software development best practices

  • Are product-oriented and enjoy working directly with other teams, challenging assumptions, and turning complex needs into concrete solutions

  • Can influence engineering practices and drive change without hierarchical authority: your job is not done until your solution is adopted

  • Are comfortable speaking and writing in English in your day-to-day with the team

 

Now, it would be fantastic if you:

  • Have experience with applied ML techniques such as embeddings, clustering, statistical sampling, and distribution monitoring

  • Have experience building developer platforms or internal tooling, or in a Forward Deployed Engineering role

  • Have experience in the medical domain or another regulated environment

 

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance (basic package) for you and your children

  • 25 days of paid vacation per year, plus up to 14 days of RTT

  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care

  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy

  • Lunch vouchers (Swile card) worth €8.50 per working day, with €4.50 covered by Doctolib

  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class

  • 50% reimbursement of your public transport subscription

  • Enrollment in Doctolib's long-term employee value sharing plan called DoctoGrowth

  • ParentCare Program: Enjoy full salary coverage (100%) during your first month of birth leave, and 75% during the second, covered by Doctolib

  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support

 

The interview process

  • A first interview with a member of the Talent Acquisition team

  • A coding interview

  • An agentics system design

  • A behavioural interview

  • Reference check

 

Job details

  • Permanent position

  • Full Time

  • Workplace: Levallois

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

Gross margin et comptabilité énergie
  • Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers
  • Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation
  • Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive
    • Fiscalité énergie et TVA
  • Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA
  • Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes
  • Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting
    • Supervision et contrôle
  • Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum)
  • Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations
    • Structuration et amélioration continue
  • Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre
  • Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite
  • Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles

    • Au-delà de 6 mois :

  • Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni

  • Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart inexpliqué, tu ne te contentes pas de le corriger, tu remontes à la cause et tu fais en sorte qu’il ne se reproduise pas
  • Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer

description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You would own Mews' relationships with the press, turning company news, product launches and leadership insight into credible coverage across hospitality, travel, technology and business media. This is a new role, the first dedicated media relations seat at Mews, so the contacts you build and the way you work will set the standard for how we deal with the press. Hospitality technology offers good stories and unusual data to pitch, and leaders here respond to press requests within about a day.</p> <p>You would join the Communications team within Marketing and work closely with the communications lead, the colleagues who shape our stories, and leadership, product marketing and regional marketing. Day to day you would pitch journalists directly, host press briefings, handle inbound enquiries and prepare leaders to speak well in front of the press. The role is remote first in Europe, ideally near London, Berlin or Paris where many of the journalists we work with are based, with about 10% travel to meet press and attend events such as Unfold.</p> <p>Journalists respond to people they know and trust, not to mass pitches, and the strongest coverage comes from a specialist who holds those relationships personally. Mews has strong stories and data to offer, and this role exists so that someone owns that conversation: choosing the right journalist for each story, answering inbound questions quickly and accurately, and knowing when to escalate something sensitive. Done well, it builds the company's reputation with the people who cover our industry over the long term.</p> <h4>What you would do</h4> <ul> <li>Build and maintain direct relationships with journalists across hospitality, travel, technology and business media: develop stories with the communications team, pitch them proactively by phone and email, host press briefings and invite journalists to events such as Unfold.</li> <li>Respond to inbound press enquiries (currently two to three a week and growing) quickly and accurately, and escalate anything potentially sensitive to the communications lead straight away.</li> <li>Brief and coach executive and local spokespeople, and share what you learn from journalists with leadership.</li> <li>Redesign how media monitoring, journalist research and coverage reporting work using AI, and set the workflows up so the rest of the team can use them.</li> <li>Own and improve the team's media management tool, and check every AI-assisted pitch, briefing or summary before it reaches a journalist.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> in this role that means you have gone well beyond using AI to draft copy. You have redesigned parts of how media relations work gets done, such as monitoring, journalist research or coverage reporting, you have built approaches that colleagues now follow, and you actively question and check what AI gives you, including target lists, summaries and quotes, before anything reaches a journalist or a spokesperson.</p> <p><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to <a href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></p> <h4>What you would bring</h4> <ul> <li>Seven to ten years in PR and communications with depth in B2B media relations, including time in a PR agency.</li> <li>Your own journalist contacts and hands-on experience pitching by phone, email and in person, with fully fluent English, written and spoken.</li> <li>A record of handling reactive and sensitive press enquiries under time pressure, with clear habits about when to escalate.</li> <li>Confidence preparing senior and non-expert spokespeople for press conversations.</li> <li>AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience, shown through tools or workflows you have built for media relations work, not only content you have written with AI.</li> </ul> <h4>Nice to have</h4> <ul> <li>French or German alongside fluent English, or existing relationships with journalists in the UK, France, Germany or the US.</li> <li>Experience with B2B technology clients or in hospitality.</li> <li>Experience measuring coverage and coordinating local expertise in markets where you have fewer contacts.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£59,000</span><span We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Required Skills and Experience

  • MBIST and memory repair integration.

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

Senior Executive Assistant – Bilingual English 

This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Paris, with 4 days on-site per week.

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll report directly to one of Mirakl's Co-CEOs, in a highly visible and trusted role at the heart of the company's executive leadership. In this position, you will act as an indispensable partner to the Co-CEO, ensuring seamless day-to-day operations with exceptional rigor, anticipation, and absolute confidentiality.

2. Your Impact

  • Serve as a trusted and highly organised partner to the Co-CEO, managing their complex and constantly evolving calendar with precision — anticipating conflicts, prioritising competing demands, and protecting their time for strategic focus.
  • Own end-to-end domestic and international travel arrangements (flights, hotels, ground transport, visas, itineraries), ensuring all logistics are fully confirmed well in advance and proactively resolving any disruptions before or during trips.
  • Prepare, submit, and follow up on expense reports with accuracy and rigor, ensuring timely processing and full compliance with internal policies.
  • Act as a key point of contact between the Co-CEO and internal or external stakeholders, coordinating meetings, preparing briefing materials and agendas, and ensuring rigorous follow-up on commitments and actions.
  • Handle all sensitive, confidential, and strategically critical information with absolute discretion.

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • 10 to 15 years of experience as an Executive Assistant, Senior Executive Assistant, or Executive Business Partner
  • Proven track record supporting C-level or top-tier executives in a fast-paced, international environment
  • Demonstrated expertise in complex travel management, expense processing, and confidential executive support
  • Experience working in a high-growth, global organisation, managing multiple priorities and senior stakeholders simultaneously

Skills:

  • Exceptional organisational skills and rigor — you are known for your reliability, precision, and follow-through
  • Absolute discretion when handling sensitive business, strategic, and personnel information
  • Strong anticipation and proactivity — you resolve issues before they become problems
  • Excellent communication skills in English (full professional bilingualism required)
  • Genuine curiosity for AI and digital tools, with a drive to leverage them to improve efficiency

  3. Values Interview with Talent Acquisition (~1 hour)— A STAR-based interview with a Talent Acquisition Manager to explore how you embody Mirakl's values 
  4. Last Interview — Meet the Co-CEO to assess mutual fit and discuss the role, priorities, and expectations in greater depth

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About IonQ:&nbsp;</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&amp;index=7&amp;md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f" target="_blank">IonQ, Inc</a></u>. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C&amp;index=8&amp;md5=a7f94ee9b71a392dca3cd6c413722e51" target="_blank">Amazon Web Services, </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=and&amp;index=9&amp;md5=2bed627b388878763f41ffe0e4edb16c" target="_blank">and </a></u><u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=AstraZeneca&amp;index=10&amp;md5=757c1f2c2ec94cf3982700106122164f" target="_blank">AstraZeneca</a></u> achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, <u><a href="https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&amp;url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&amp;esheet=54451094&amp;newsitemid=20260316477473&amp;lan=en-US&amp;anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&amp;index=11&amp;md5=32e9cb88afbd439026a352666cc72c91" target="_blank">setting a world record in quantum computing performance</a></u>.<br><br>Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. &nbsp;</p></div><p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong>What to expect</strong></span></span></span></p> <p>We are looking for a Staff System Architect to be fully dedicated to the SNSPD product line, with a strong focus on leading the technical architecture and roadmap for our next-generation rack-mountable SNSPD (Superconducting Nanowire Single-Photon Detector) platform. This role is critical to defining and guiding the technical evolution of our cutting-edge cryogenic photon detection systems, ensuring architectural coherence across hardware, software, and integration domains while supporting our product vision and market requirements.</p> <p>We are looking for a proven architect of complex, multi-domain instruments, whether from space systems, astronomical instrumentation, scientific or medical imaging, electron or advanced optical microscopy, semiconductor equipment, or comparable fields who can bring that system-level rigour to our platform.</p> <p><span class="s1"><span class="TextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW3980620 BCX0"><strong><span class="TextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW243108471 BCX0">What you'll be doing</span></span></strong></span></span></span></p> <p>In this role, you will be an integral part of the development process for IDQ's SNSPD platform, with applications across quantum computing, networking, and sensing. You will be at the intersection of quantum photonics, cryogenic systems engineering and embedded systems to create scalable, maintainable architectures for autonomous 24/7 detector operations.</p> <p>You will take ownership of the end-to-end system architecture of the SNSPD platform, ensuring alignment with a shared long-term product vision while translating product requirements into clear system-level designs and specifications. This includes defining system structure, interfaces, and key architectural decisions, as well as driving critical trade-offs across performance, cost, scalability, and integration. You will also align engineering execution with the architectural vision, guiding system integration and resolving complex cross-domain design challenges.</p> <p>In addition, you will play a key role in shaping the technology roadmap and driving the evolution of the platform, continuously evaluating and introducing new technologies where relevant to maintain innovation and competitiveness.</p> <ul> <li>Lead system architecture, design decisions, and cross-functional alignment to ensure a scalable and high-performing SNSPD platform</li> <li>Drive technology roadmap, integration, and innovation by evaluating and implementing new technologies</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">What you'll bring</span></strong></p> <p>We are seeking an experienced professional with a Master's degree (PhD preferred) in physics, electrical engineering, photonics, or a related field, and 7+ years of experience in the design of complex, multi-domain systems, with demonstrated ownership of system architecture. The ideal candidate has architected instruments or platforms of comparable complexity, combining optics or photonics with electronics, mechanics or thermal design, and embedded or software components and has proven experience integrating these technologies into cohesive, high-performing products.</p> <p>You will demonstrate strong technical leadership across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to clearly communicate complex system architectures to a wide range of stakeholders. This includes ensuring alignment, supporting informed decision-making, and driving successful collaboration across functions to deliver robust and scalable system designs.</p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in system architecture and multi-domain integration, with strong system-level thinking</li> <li>Proven technical leadership and communication skills, enabling alignment and effective decision-making across diverse teams</li> </ul> <p><strong><span class="s1">You'll be a great fit with</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Background in domains of comparable complexity: space instrumentation, astronomy, high-end microscopy or imaging, semiconductor or scientific equipment</li> <li>Experience with photonics, low-noise electronics, cryogenics, or vacuum systems</li> <li>Experience with SNSPDs, single-photon detection, or quantum systems</li> <li>Experience bringing industrialized or rack-mountable systems to market</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Compensation will vary based on individual factors such as education, qualifications, and experience of the final candidate(s), specific office location, and calibration against relevant market data and internal team equity. Posted base salary figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. Our benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans, matching 401(k), unlimited PTO and paid holidays, parental/adoption leave, legal insurance, and a home technology stipend. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided when a candidate receives an offer of employment.&nbsp;</p> <p>At IonQ, we believe in fair treatment, access, opportunity, and advancement for all while striving to identify and eliminate barriers. We empower employees to thrive by fostering a culture of autonomy, productivity, and respect. We are dedicated to creating an environment where individuals can feel welcomed, respected, supported, and valued.<br>&nbsp;<br>We are committed to equity and justice. We welcome different voices and viewpoints and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, ancestry, physical and/or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, age, sexual orientation, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. We are proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>The position you are applying for will require access to technology that is subject to U.S. export control and government contract restrictions.&nbsp; Employment with IonQ is contingent on either verifying “U.S. Person” (e.g., U.S. citizen, U.S. national, U.S. permanent resident, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum) status for export controls and government contracts work, obtaining any necessary license, and/or confirming the availability of a license exception under U.S. export controls.&nbsp; Please note that in the absence of confirming you are a U.S. Person for export control and government contracts work purposes, IonQ may choose not to apply for a license or decline to use a license exception (if available) for you to access export-controlled technology that may require authorization, and similarly, you may not qualify for government contracts work that requires U.S. Persons, and IonQ may decline to proceed with your application on those bases alone.&nbsp; Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>US Non-Technical Jobs.&nbsp;</strong>Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum. Accordingly, we will have some additional questions regarding your immigration status that will be used for export control and compliance purposes, and the answers will be reviewed by compliance personnel to ensure compliance with federal law.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>If you are interested in being a part of our team and mission, we encourage you to apply!&nbsp;</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager (m/w/d) 100%
description: Im Auftrag unseres Kunden HINT AG suchen wir einen Product Manager (m/w/d) 100% Gesundheitswesen sicher digitalisiert Wir decken die ICT-Bedürfnisse der Schweizer Spitäler, Heime und Praxen ab, sodass sich diese voll und ganz auf ihre Arbeit konzentrieren können. Du entwickelst gerne Angebote, kannst Menschen dafür gewinnen und bringst die Umsetzung voran. Bei uns verbindest du Branchenwissen mit kommerziellem Gespür und gestaltest Produkte und Services mit konkretem Kundennutzen. Du bringst dein Verständnis für die Abläufe und Herausforderungen von Spitälern, Heimen und Praxen in die Weiterentwicklung unserer Produktstrategie und unseres Portfolios ein. Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse und Marktpotenziale und entwickelst daraus gemeinsam mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Partnern passende, standardisierte und wirtschaftliche Angebote. Du führst die Beteiligten zusammen, klärst Anforderungen und Verantwortlichkeiten und treibst die Entwicklung und Markteinführung unserer Produkte und Services voran. Du unterstützt Sales und Account Management in Kundengesprächen, Workshops und Angebotspräsentationen. Dabei vermittelst du den fachlichen und wirtschaftlichen Nutzen unserer Leistungen überzeugend. Du präsentierst unsere Angebote und relevante Digitalisierungsthemen bei Kundenveranstaltungen, Fachanlässen und in Vorträgen. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit Sales und Marketing die Positionierung, Verkaufsargumente und Unterlagen für eine erfolgreiche Vermarktung. Du kalkulierst Produktkosten mit den zuständigen Fachbereichen, wirkst bei Preisen und Verrechnungsmodellen mit und beurteilst die Wirtschaftlichkeit des Portfolios. Du begleitest den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus von der Einführung über die Weiterentwicklung bis zur Ablösung und lässt Rückmeldungen aus Vertrieb und Betrieb gezielt einfliessen. Du stellst verständliche und aktuelle Produktinformationen im Servicekatalog und Webshop sicher und wirkst bei der Weiterentwicklung unseres standardisierten Hardware-Sortiments mit. Dein Profil Du kennst das Schweizer Gesundheitswesen aus eigener Berufserfahrung, vorzugsweise direkt bei einem Leistungserbringer wie einem Spital, Heim oder Praxisverbund. Du verstehst klinische, pflegerische oder administrative Abläufe und erkennst, wo digitale Lösungen im Alltag einen Mehrwert schaffen. Du bringst Erfahrung im Produktmanagement, Business Development, Lösungsvertrieb oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion an der Schnittstelle zwischen Gesundheitswesen, ICT und Markt mit. Du kannst verkaufen: Du erkennst Kundenbedürfnisse, formulierst überzeugende Nutzenargumente und begeisterst unterschiedliche Anspruchsgruppen für eine Lösung. Du trittst sicher auf und präsentierst gerne – im persönlichen Kundengespräch ebenso wie in Workshops oder vor einem grösseren Publikum. Du bist kommunikationsstark, vernetzt Menschen und koordinierst die Zusammenarbeit über Bereichs- und Unternehmensgrenzen hinweg. Du packst an, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst Themen mit Eigeninitiative, Struktur und Beharrlichkeit zum Abschluss. description: Help fix customer-centricity at scale Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact. Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture. Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world. If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together. The role Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act. Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter. You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan . You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe. Why this role, now The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it. Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next. This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do. What you'll do This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does. Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book. Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature. Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook. Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates What this role isn't We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in. It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role. It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline. It isn't a finished machine. raw.title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
raw.description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

title: Senior Sales Operations Manager (South EMEA)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p>As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will support the EMEA South Go-To-Market team as a trusted advisor to sales leaders, enabling consistent, predictable, and repeatable hyper-growth through sales discipline, streamlined processes, and a strong operating cadence. You will partner with the EMEA South Leadership Team on GTM design, business analysis, and metrics while managing the day-to-day rhythm of the business, with field productivity as your north star. This role is based in Amsterdam, Prague, or Milan, and is ideal for someone who wants to be an active voice driving change rather than a passive spectator.</p> <h3>What Will You Do?</h3> <p>Primary responsibilities include:</p> <ul> <li>Serve as the EMEA South Operations Lead and trusted advisor to key sales leaders, actively participating in the EMEA forecasting process, advising on changing pipeline dynamics, and challenging forecasts to ensure accuracy, predictability, and transparency.</li> <li>Manage Area business metrics including performance, trends, headcount, and investment models, and lead the development of key sales metrics and business review materials, monitoring performance and taking action to optimize business results.</li> <li>Drive the annual sales planning process, including Area, Regional, and District goal assignments, territory management updates, and sales compensation plan changes.</li> <li>Identify gaps in the infrastructure needed to support Sales and develop solutions, with a strong focus on AI, that align to the team’s overall vision, while educating and training teams on key sales processes.</li> <li>Act as an active voice that drives change with Area leadership, and align with the Global Revenue Operations team to represent the needs of the field.</li> </ul> <h3>What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?</h3> <p>Ideal candidates will have:</p> <ul> <li>7 to 10 years of experience in Sales, Revenue, or Field Operations supporting sales teams, with a strong emphasis on enabling teams to be hyper-productive, ideally within organizations selling subscription security software.</li> <li>Experience designing and scaling processes that support a hyper-growth business model, including documenting key processes in a publicly traded environment.</li> <li>Proven analytical ability to turn disparate datasets into insightful analytics, including developing messaging, data visualizations, and executive-level presentations.</li> <li>Solid experience with a key tech stack including Salesforce, Clari, Tableau, MS Office, G-Suite, and AI tools.</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence sales teams, build collaborative relationships across functions, and translate the complex needs of the field. A Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Management, Technology, or Economics is required, and an MBA is a plus.</li> </ul> <h3>Why SentinelOne?</h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity &amp; Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off &amp; Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance &amp; Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Insurance and medical allowance</li> <li>Pension scheme</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks &amp; Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Commuter or work-from-home allowance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellness &amp; Lifestyle</strong></p> <ul> <li>Wellness benefit</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.&nbsp;</span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our&nbsp;<a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Group Finance Contractor
description: Build with us Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe. Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow — with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable. With 1,000+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions. We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of. Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together. Your impact We're looking for an experienced Finance Contractor to join our Accounting team for an initial 6–9 month period. You'll help keep the wheels turning on our day to day accounting, supporting the monthly and yearly close process, while also bringing a fresh pair of eyes to how we can do things better. This is a hands-on, broad remit. You'll pitch in wherever the team needs support, from general ledger and reconciliations to month end deliverables, and you'll have the chance to help us tighten up processes and controls along the way. Jouw advies voorkomt dat hoogspanningsverbindingen risico’s voor de omgeving veroorzaken. Zo maak jij de uitbreiding van het Nederlandse energienet veilig en verantwoord mogelijk.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je adviseert toonaangevende opdrachtgevers over complexe elektromagnetische beïnvloeding rond hoogspanningsverbindingen.

Als senior adviseur EMC overzie je complexe vraagstukken rond elektromagnetische beïnvloeding. Je beoordeelt welke normen van toepassing zijn, doorziet vroegtijdig de gevolgen voor assets van derden en adviseert over passende maatregelen. Je kijkt verder dan afzonderlijke berekeningen, waarbij je project overstijgende risico’s signaleert, de scope afbakent en klanten helpt weloverwogen keuzes te maken. Je werkt voor onder meer netbeheerders, infrabeheerders en eigenaren van kabels en leidingen.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met overtuigende adviesvaardigheden. title: Backend Software Developer
description: Backend Software Developer – Maatwerk Software met Impact Wij weten dat wat op het eerste gezicht eenvoudig lijkt, vaak complexer is dan men denkt. En wij begrijpen dat technologie geen barrière mag zijn, maar juist de verbinding naar een bestendige maatschappij. Bij Dawn Technology bouwen we niet zomaar digitale oplossingen. We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Binnen onze Smart Devices afdeling bouwen we apps die impact maken. Van media apps voor bedrijven als Pathé en de NPO met miljoenen gebruikers, tot de app van het KNMI waarmee we belangrijke weerswaarschuwingen zoals code rood meldingen afgeven. We maken geen compromissen op kwaliteit en zoeken altijd naar de best mogelijke oplossing, tot in de kleinste details. Om onze groeiambities te realiseren zoeken we een Backend Software Developer . Iemand die energie krijgt van het ontwikkelen van sterke backend-omgevingen, het schrijven van strakke code en het operationeel krijgen én houden van de onderliggende cloud-infrastructuur voor applicaties met miljoenen gebruikers. Jouw rol Als Backend Software Developer ben je een onmisbare schakel in de backend-trajecten van onze applicaties. Je bouwt de schaalbare, onzichtbare motor achter hoogwaardige innovaties en zorgt dat onze infrastructuur robuust staat. Je bent analytisch sterk en je krijgt er energie van om technische requirements te vertalen naar logische cloud-infrastructuren die je vervolgens zélf bouwt. Je werkt nauw samen met onze multidisciplinaire ontwikkelteams en zorgt dat de code soepel draait. Geen haastwerk, maar engineering met diepgang en visie. Wat je zal gaan doen: Ontwikkelen en operationeel maken van serverless backends en event-driven API's met TypeScript (AWS Lambda / Serverless Functions). Zelfstandig opzetten van cloud-infrastructuren met behulp van Infrastructure as Code (bijv. via AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation). Proactief meedenken over en het inrichten van CI/CD pipelines, applicatie-uptime en databeveiliging. Bijdragen aan de codekwaliteit door middel van code reviews en het actief delen van kennis met jouw teamleden. Effectief asynchroon samenwerken, documenteren en code opleveren binnen een distributed, remote-first team. Wie ben jij? We zoeken een developer met een HBO werk- en denkniveau die al de nodige stappen heeft gezet in het bouwen van cloud-native applicaties . Je hebt sterke ervaring met de TypeScript/Node.js stack en modern software-development zoals Agile/Scrum, CI/CD en Infrastructure as Code kent voor jou geen geheimen. Je bent niet alleen een developer, maar je kunt ook écht zelf cloudomgevingen operationeel krijgen en beheren met tools als AWS CDK, Terraform of CloudFormation . Algemene cloud kennis is een vereiste; specifieke ervaring met AWS of Scaleway is een pre . Je geniet van technische puzzels, levert graag goed geteste code op en voelt je thuis in een Node.js backend. Verder ben je woonachtig in Nederland . Wat bieden wij jou? De Organisatie : Snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie : Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact : De kans om bij te dragen aan bekende, maatschappelijk relevante applicaties voor platformen zoals NPO Start, Pathé Thuis en het KNMI binnen een uitstekend beoordeeld top-tier maatwerk softwarebedrijf (Emerce100 koploper). Salaris : Bruto maandsalaris tussen de €4000,- en €6000,- passend bij jouw ervaring. Vakantiedagen : 25 vakantiedagen om lekker uit te rusten. Werkplek & Sfeer : Een fijne remote-first cultuur met volledige flexibiliteit, een gezellige werksfeer en inspirerende maandelijkse co-working dagen. Mobiliteit & Thuiswerken : Kilometervergoeding van €0,25/km of volledige OV-vergoeding, gecombineerd met een maandelijkse thuiswerkvergoeding. Pensioen : Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen. Ontwikkeling & Extra's : Ruime mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen, plus actieve deelname en toegang tot het eigen event Appdevcon en diverse kennissessies. De 'Gadget Kit' : Een high-end MacBook Pro, een 27 inch 5K display, testdevices en een volledig ingerichte thuiswerkplek. Events & Fun : Toffe teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis. Onze klanten komen uit sectoren die er écht toe doen – van zorg en educatie tot duurzaamheid en publieke dienstverlening. We verstoppen complexiteit achter eenvoud en bouwen software die logisch voelt. En precies dát maakt ons werk elke dag boeiend. Samen met een groep van bijna 250 digitale specialisten delen we kennis, zoeken we de nieuwste technologieën op en versterken we elkaar. Benieuwd om te horen hoe het is om bij Dawn Technology te werken? Luister dan eens naar deze podcast . Solliciteren Spreekt deze rol je aan? Laat je gegevens dan achter via de sollicitatieknop. Ook als je twijfelt of je volledig aansluit nodigen we je uit om te solliciteren. Nog vragen naar aanleiding van deze vacature? Neem dan gerust contact op met Dennis Timmerman (Corporate Recruiter) via 0638675360 . Have a great day. Dawn Technology. We gebruiken voor nieuwe kandidaten een assessment (actueel binnen software ontwikkeling) om het niveau objectief vast te stellen. Hiermee onderbouwen we de totstandkoming van het salaris in het recruitmentproces op basis van feitelijke vaardigheden. Dit geeft ons een eerlijk en meetbaar kader voor iedereen. title: Interim Senior Community Manager
description: Who we are We believe travel can create Citizens of the World. When people cross Europe slowly, by train, they come back more curious, more open and better able to understand people unlike themselves.   With colleagues from more than 50 countries, our diversity sparks curiosity, insight and a culture of openness, which is essential to understanding our travellers and one another.   Three values connect everyone at Interrail: we lead with our purpose, we own our impact, and we choose for growth.   We work in a hybrid way, from our office in Utrecht and our homes across the Netherlands. We’re on the search for... Someone who has built a community for a brand before, and who can bring ours to life online and offline. Since 1959, Interrail has been more than a rail pass. We’re now building it into a cultural movement, and our community is where that movement becomes real: the deeper you travel through Europe, the more the journey changes you, told by the people who lived it. In 2027 our community moves into the Interrail app and website. Our product and technical team builds the platform. You make it a community: you shape the community vision, bring the first members in, and create the moments, online and in real life, that make travellers come back and help each other. The Brand team shapes what Interrail stands for and how it shows up wherever travellers meet us. We own our brand platform and positioning, and our community, bringing The Interrail Effect to life through the people who’ve travelled with us. We work closely with Product, Social & Community, Creative & Content, CRM, and the PR & Partnerships teams to keep every touchpoint consistent and culturally sharp. This is a nine-month interim contract. The team meets in the office a minimum of twice per week, so you’ll be required to join those days to work alongside your colleagues.   What you’ll be doing You’ll be part of the Brand team, reporting to the Brand Lead who owns the Community Program. You’ll lead the community from launch to a community that’s live, safe, well populated and growing, online and offline. The community isn’t a loyalty scheme or a fan club. It’s where travellers tell the truth about their journeys, inspire others and help the next person go and experience it. You’ll work closely with Product (Social Connection and Loyalty team), Customer Experience, Legal and Privacy, PR & Partnerships, Social, and our Creator Partnerships and Creative colleagues. You’ll be: Shaping the community vision, values and member code with the Brand Lead, and laying the foundations for Interrail as a cultural movement, online and offline. Building the community strategy: who we bring in first, which journeys launch first and how the community grows after launch. Bringing our existing members across as founding voices, and working with Content and Marketing to onboard our Pioneers. Launching the first community rituals, and making the community a source of real traveller stories for the brand. Designing and running a first pilot of real-world moments, such as gatherings at stations or partner places, with PR & Partnerships and Social. Building good relationships with the independent Interrail communities on Facebook, Reddit and beyond. We partner with them; we never try to replace them. Keeping the community safe: setting guidelines, the moderation approach with Customer Experience, and working with Legal, Privacy, and Safety so nothing goes live until it’s signed off. Being the members’ voice in our Product team, measuring community health with Analytics and CRM, and creating a playbook so what you build lasts. What we’re looking for Here’s what will help you in this role. If you don’t match every point, we’d still love to hear from you. 8+ years building communities for brands, including at least one you grew from launch. Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs. You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow. A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it. Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR. A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams. Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract. A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures. Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.    Curious to apply? Apply directly through our careers page .   We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through. For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.   If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.   To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.   In the meantime If you’re curious, why not check us out on LinkedIn and get a sense of our culture and values?   Got questions? Our team would be happy to help: just drop us a note at   While you’re here, you can plan your own trip and find your Pass at www.interrail.com . Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

  • Experience running community both online and in real life, such as events, meet-ups or ambassador programs.

  • You have written a community vision or strategy and turned it into a plan that others follow.

  • A track record of building early momentum, so people join and champion the community, not just follow it.

  • Experience setting moderation and safety policies, and comfort working with Legal and Privacy on consent, safeguarding and GDPR.

  • A clear point of view on what makes a community healthy, and the confidence to defend it with product teams.

  • Organised, good at documenting and comfortable working across many teams, so what you build outlasts your contract.

  • A genuine interest in train travel, meeting locals, new experiences and other cultures.

Bonus points for experience with community platforms or social SDKs, multilingual moderation, or a long rail trip through Europe of your own.

  

Curious to apply?

Apply directly through our careers page.

 

  • We’ll ask you to share your CV in English (our business language) and tell us why you’re interested in Interrail and this role. It doesn’t hurt to be creative; we enjoy seeing your personality shine through.

  • For some roles, we may also ask you to complete a short task based on the real job, so you can show us your skills in practice.

 

If we’d like to get to know you better, the next step is a first conversation with Talent Acquisition, followed by interviews with the team. It’s a two-way conversation: a chance for you to explore Interrail, and for us to get to know you.

 

To keep our hiring fair, we use blind screening in the early stages. Your name, photo, date of birth, gender, nationality, contact details and social media links are hidden, so our first decisions are based only on your skills, experience and potential.

 

In the meantime

You will collaborate closely with other product teams and departments, from Sales to Marketing to Customer Support, serving both internal and external customers. We expect you to lead and enable your team to deliver effectively, setting the right technical direction while leveraging the talent present in your team. While we expect you to be technical, your focus will be on strategy and leadership rather than heavy hands-on coding. AI is changing how we build software, and we are going all in. You will lead a team that uses AI in its daily work, from writing and reviewing code to planning, testing and decision-making. We expect you to be a hands-on practitioner who uses these tools yourself and pushes your team to get the most out of them. Our Tech Stack At the Backend we mostly use Go, Postgres, and Redis. We practise DevOps, Continuous Delivery, Domain Driven Design, and Contract Driven Development.   Your role In your daily role, your impact will be defined by key pillars: Delivery, Direction, Talent, and Culture. Talent : Nurture talent with regular feedback and performance reviews, supporting career growth. You will identify skill gaps and execute hiring strategies to acquire top talent. Culture : Lead by example to foster ownership, empowerment, and autonomy. You will promote a growth mindset, value diverse perspectives, and address problems to maintain a healthy team culture. Craft : Equip your team to solve problems with pragmatic, sustainable solutions. You will foster engineering excellence, support knowledge-sharing, and keep the team up to date with the latest technical trends. AI-first engineering : Make AI a core part of how your team works, not an experiment on the side. description: Ben jij ready voor Change? Bij Change zoeken we een Talent acquisition Lead die recruitment naar een hoger niveau brengt. Je werft zelf actief mee en bent daarnaast de senior op de afdeling: je coacht junior recruiters, brengt structuur aan in de dagelijkse operatie en helpt het team groeien in eigenaarschap, kwaliteit en resultaat. Daarmee maak je meteen helder: dit is geen gewone recruiterrol, maar een combinatie van zelf doen, richting geven en mensen beter maken . Hier ga je werken: Bij Change kom je terecht in een energieke en snelgroeiende organisatie waar ontwikkeling, samenwerking en beweging centraal staan. We werken voor bekende merken zoals Marktplaats, Odido en Eneco en zorgen iedere dag voor de beste klantbeleving. Onze organisatie groeit hard en recruitment speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We zoeken daarom iemand die zelf stevig in de werving staat, maar ook het recruitmentteam verder helpt ontwikkelen. Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management, HR en collega-recruiters. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid, ruimte om mee te denken en de kans om zichtbaar impact te maken op de groei van Change. Waar ben je verantwoordelijk voor? Actieve sourcing en hunting Je zoekt actief naar commercieel talent via LinkedIn, jobboards en netwerken. Je weet latent werkzoekenden te vinden en te enthousiasmeren voor Change. Coaching en ontwikkeling van het recruitmentteam Je begeleidt en coacht recruiters in sourcing, selectie, stakeholdermanagement en kandidaatcommunicatie. Je deelt kennis en helpt het team groeien in kwaliteit en eigenaarschap. Operationele aansturing Je brengt structuur aan, bewaakt de voortgang van vacatures en helpt het team prioriteiten stellen. Businesspartner voor sales en operatie Je werkt nauw samen met teamleads, management en HR en vertaalt personeelsbehoeften naar effectieve recruitmentacties. Candidate experience Je zorgt voor een professioneel en persoonlijk recruitmentproces waarin kandidaten zich gezien voelen. Procesverbetering en data Je optimaliseert recruitmentprocessen en gebruikt data om resultaten en effectiviteit te verbeteren. Talentpools Je bouwt aan talentpools voor commerciële en specialistische functies, zodat we ook op de lange termijn succesvol kunnen blijven werven. Wij vinden het belangrijk dat wij bij elkaar passen. Herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden? Eerlijk – Je communiceert open, duidelijk en betrouwbaar.  Beweging – Je pakt aan, denkt vooruit en brengt energie in elk project.  Anders – Je ziet mogelijkheden, durft te vernieuwen en houdt het praktisch.  Expertise – Je werkt gestructureerd, deelt kennis en maakt dingen af.  Wat breng je mee? Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen recruitment, bij voorkeur in een dynamische, commerciële of snelgroeiende organisatie. Je hebt ervaring met actieve sourcing en weet hoe je latent werkzoekenden benadert en overtuigt. Je vindt het leuk om junior recruiters te coachen, te begeleiden en beter te maken in hun vak. Je hebt ambitie om leiding te geven. Je bent sterk in stakeholdermanagement en schakelt makkelijk met teamleads, management, HR en recruiters. Je brengt structuur, overzicht en rust in een omgeving waar veel tegelijk gebeurt. Je hebt ervaring met interviewtechnieken, ATS-systemen en recruitmentdata. Je weet hoe je commercieel talent herkent en kunt beoordelen op salesdrive, overtuigingskracht, eigenaarschap en resultaatgerichtheid. Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en krijgt energie van targets, groei en resultaat. Je durft mensen aan te spreken op eigenaarschap, opvolging en kwaliteit. Je denkt mee over processen, maar blijft niet hangen in plannen. Jij zorgt dat dingen gebeuren. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend in de Nederlandse taal. Ervaring met employer branding of doelgroepgerichte arbeidsmarktcommunicatie is mooi meegenomen. Wat wij jou bieden! Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende en dynamische organisatie. Een salaris tussen €4.500 en €5.500 per maand (op fulltime basis). Een aantrekkelijke bonusstructuur op basis van prestaties en resultaten. Een contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week. Km vergoeding of NS businesscard voor jouw woon- werk verkeer. Veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling. Een ambitieus en energiek team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. De mogelijkheid om écht impact te maken op de groei van onze commerciële organisatie. Ready for Change? Zie jij het als een uitdaging om zelf sterke commerciële kandidaten aan Change te verbinden én een recruitmentteam verder te ontwikkelen? Dan leren we je graag kennen. title: Stage tijdschriftredactie Libelle
description: Amsterdam  – Wil jij ontdekken hoe een tijdschriftredactie werkt, van eerste idee tot een verhaal in print én online? En lijkt het je leuk om mee te denken én te werken aan rubrieken en artikelen in Libelle? Dan hebben wij misschien wel een plek voor jou op de human interest-redactie. Op de human interest-redactie maken we de journalistieke producties voor Libelle. Denk aan de interviews met BN’ers, persoonlijke verhalen, vaste rubrieken zoals De dag nadat en Hoe het begon, columns en de verhalen over psychologie, gezondheid, maatschappij en werk & geld. Wat ga je doen? Je werkt mee aan vaste rubrieken in Libelle (bijv. In gesprek met Libelle, De Denktank, Hoe het begon) Je neemt zelf interviews af voor rubrieken in print en mogelijk ook online. Je bedenkt onderwerpen die aansluiten bij de doelgroep en pitcht ideeën voor de HI-planning. Je ondersteunt de human interest-redactie (de redactiemanager, coördinator en producer) bij de dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Het gaat om een fulltime stage (32 tot 40 uur) per februari 2027. Wil je op een later moment stagelopen? Reageer vooral, dan kijken we vast naar de mogelijkheden. De stagiair die wij zoeken: Volgt een relevante HBO- of universitaire opleiding (bijvoorbeeld Journalistiek of Creative Business). Beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend en schrijft foutloos. Weet wat er speelt. Is een creatieve schrijver. Kan makkelijk schakelen tussen print en online. Heeft affiniteit met de doelgroep van Libelle. Heeft een proactieve houding. Is vanaf februari voor 5 á 6 maanden beschikbaar en minimaal 3 dagen per week. Wat krijg je van ons? ● Een leuke omgeving, goede begeleiding, borrels en de gezelligste collega’s. ● Een unieke stage om ervaring op te doen. ● Een marktconforme stagevergoeding van €400,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband. ● En een laptop van de zaak. Stagelopen bij DPG Media Stagelopen bij DPG Media betekent niet alleen dat je de door jou geleerde theorie in de praktijk brengt door een bijdrage te leveren aan onze ambitieuze teams, ook ga je bij ons écht wat leren. Een aanvulling ben je zeker, want jouw creatieve en frisse blik wordt erg gewaardeerd. Na je stage kan je zeggen dat je ook nog eens écht toffe dingen hebt bereikt én hebt gewerkt bij het grootste mediabedrijf van Nederland. Zet dat maar op je cv! Over DPG Media DPG Media heeft met haar sterke merken een stevige marktpositie in alle onderdelen van de mediabranche. Elke dag werken we met ontzettend veel plezier aan ons portfolio dat bestaat uit uiteenlopende A-merken, waaronder AD, AutoWeek, DonaldDuck, Libelle, Margriet, Linda, NU.nl , Qmusic, vtwonen en RTL. Je wordt dus onderdeel van een groter geheel: met al onze merken bereiken we elke maand 98% van de Nederlanders. Hoe tof is dat? Interesse, en dan? Heb je direct zin om aan de slag te gaan? Solliciteer dan nu! Stuur je motivatiebrief en je cv mee met je sollicitatie. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

  • Take the lead on one or two paid acquisition channels (e.g., Meta, TikTok, Google, etc.), with potential to expand scope based on performance

We ontwikkelen hoogwaardige maatwerk software die het leven van mensen verrijkt. Achter elke krachtige applicatie staat een stabiele en schaalbare cloudinfrastructuur. Je ontwerpt, bouwt en automatiseert moderne IT-infrastructuur voor uitdagende klantprojecten. Met tools zoals Terraform en Ansible til je onze automatisering naar het hoogste niveau. Je begeleidt complexe klantmigraties van A tot Z met oog voor detail. Daarnaast borg je een uitstekende overdracht en heldere documentatie voor je collega's. Zo creëer je voorspelbare, veilige en toekomstbestendige omgevingen voor maatschappelijk relevante organisaties. Opstellen van heldere documentatie en verzorgen van een vlekkeloze kennisoverdracht. Waarborgen van de veiligheid, capaciteit en performance van het platform. Je hebt ruime ervaring met het zelfstandig ontwerpen en migreren van complete IT-omgevingen. Je communiceert helder, pakt eigenaarschap en werkt gestructureerd. De Organisatie: Je versterkt een snelgroeiende, vooruitstrevende organisatie met een sterke visie en focus op maatschappelijk relevante software. Autonomie: Je krijgt veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief, ondernemerschap en technische autonomie. Maatschappelijke Impact: Je werkt aan uitdagende projecten met een directe en tastbare maatschappelijke impact. Mobiliteit & Fiets: Een kilometervergoeding van € 0,25/km of een volledige OV-vergoeding, én een fiscaal aantrekkelijk fietsplan. Pensioen: Een uitstekend en goed geregeld pensioen voor jouw toekomst. Events & Fun: Toffe (lokale) teamactiviteiten en gezellige, bedrijfsbrede Summer en Winter Events. Over Dawn Technology We bouwen niet voor de massa, maar voor betekenis.
